units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|log|524|0
units.english: Gamboge manages construction on the Aktina Cylinder, an immense habitat station whose construction has stalled in recent years. He is frustrated about the lack of support offered by the Assembly and believes Aktina deserves to be a higher priority.
units.italian: Gamboge dirige i lavori di costruzione del Cilindro Aktina, un'immensa stazione abitativa la cui costruzione si è arenata negli ultimi anni. È frustrato dalla mancanza di sostegno offerto dall'Assemblea e ritiene che Aktina meriti una priorità più alta.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|You are struck by just how massive this space station is, even in its incomplete state. At three kilometers in diameter, it is only a small fraction of the size of the cylinders back in the Twilight, but even so it overshadows any human orbital construction. The site is an active construction zone, based on what you've heard, though you see little evidence of activity. A few Avgi lounge about in the small, temporary living quarters for the construction workers, but all of the Akoustiki Excursion Vehicles with their welding arms and nanofilament spinners are docked and powered down.|526|0
units.english: You are struck by just how massive this space station is, even in its incomplete state. At three kilometers in diameter, it is only a small fraction of the size of the cylinders back in the Twilight, but even so it overshadows any human orbital construction. The site is an active construction zone, based on what you've heard, though you see little evidence of activity. A few Avgi lounge about in the small, temporary living quarters for the construction workers, but all of the Akoustiki Excursion Vehicles with their welding arms and nanofilament spinners are docked and powered down.
units.italian: Sei colpito da quanto sia immensa questa stazione spaziale, anche nello stato incompleto. Con tre chilometri di diametro è solo una piccola frazione della dimensione dei cilindri del Twilight, ma anche così sovrasta qualsiasi costruzione orbitale umana. Il cantiere è una zona di costruzione attiva, da quanto hai sentito, anche se vedi poche tracce di attività. Qualche Avgi ozia nei piccoli alloggi temporanei degli operai, ma tutti gli Akoustiki Excursion Vehicles, con i loro bracci saldanti e i filatori di nanofibra, sono attraccati e spenti.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	Would you like to ask what's going on?|527|0
units.english: Would you like to ask what's going on?
units.italian: Vorresti chiedere che cosa succede?

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	(Yes.)|529|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	(Not right now.)|530|0
units.english: (Not right now.)
units.italian: (Non ora.)

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	You find a deep yellow Avgi, dressed in metallic blue-colored bangles around his limbs and forward body, perched in a makeshift office behind a pile of boxes. "Hey, do you mind if I ask some questions about this station?" you say.|535|0
units.english: You find a deep yellow Avgi, dressed in metallic blue-colored bangles around his limbs and forward body, perched in a makeshift office behind a pile of boxes. "Hey, do you mind if I ask some questions about this station?" you say.
units.italian: Trovi un Avgi giallo scuro, ornato di bracciali blu metallico sulle membra e sulla parte anteriore del corpo, appollaiato in un ufficio improvvisato dietro una pila di casse. "Ehi, ti dispiace se ti faccio qualche domanda su questa stazione?" dici.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"Curiosity. Of course, alien traveler," he says, waving an arm at you. "My name is Gamboge, and I direct the construction effort on the Aktina Cylinder. What would you like to know?"|536|0
units.english: "Curiosity. Of course, alien traveler," he says, waving an arm at you. "My name is Gamboge, and I direct the construction effort on the Aktina Cylinder. What would you like to know?"
units.italian: "Curiosità. Ma certo, viaggiatore alieno," dice, agitando un braccio verso di te. "Mi chiamo Gamboge e dirigo lo sforzo costruttivo del Cilindro Aktina. Che cosa vorresti sapere?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"How long until the cylinder is done?"|539|0
units.english: "How long until the cylinder is done?"
units.italian: "Quanto manca perché il cilindro sia finito?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"What kind of station design is this?"|543|0
units.english: "What kind of station design is this?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di progetto di stazione è questo?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"What are you building this station for?"|547|0
units.english: "What are you building this station for?"
units.italian: "Per che cosa state costruendo questa stazione?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"That's all the questions I have, thank you."|551|0
units.english: "That's all the questions I have, thank you."
units.italian: "Non ho altre domande, grazie."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|label|554|0
units.english: when update
units.italian: when update

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	He thrums with laughter. "The trillion credit question, is it not, amusement? The answer I give the Assembly is that it will be finished when they supply us with the requisite materials and workforce to do so. But the War takes precedence, as it must, and so the steel and nanofibers and ceramics that we must have before we can fill this cylinder with atmosphere are instead used to build warships, and the engineers and workers with any shred of experience are sent to the Navigeo Yards instead of here."|557|0
units.english: He thrums with laughter. "The trillion credit question, is it not, amusement? The answer I give the Assembly is that it will be finished when they supply us with the requisite materials and workforce to do so. But the War takes precedence, as it must, and so the steel and nanofibers and ceramics that we must have before we can fill this cylinder with atmosphere are instead used to build warships, and the engineers and workers with any shred of experience are sent to the Navigeo Yards instead of here."
units.italian: Vibra di risate. "La domanda da mille miliardi di crediti, non è così, divertimento? La risposta che do all'Assemblea è che sarà finito quando ci forniranno i materiali e la manodopera necessari. Ma la Guerra ha la precedenza, come deve, e così l'acciaio, le nanofibre e le ceramiche che ci servono prima di poter riempire di atmosfera questo cilindro finiscono invece a costruire navi da guerra, e gli ingegneri e gli operai con un briciolo di esperienza sono mandati ai Navigeo Yards invece che qui."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"Well, it makes sense that fighting the Aberrant would take priority."|559|0
units.english: "Well, it makes sense that fighting the Aberrant would take priority."
units.italian: "Beh, ha senso che combattere l'Aberrante abbia la priorità."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"Is building this station as important as fighting the Aberrant?"|560|0
units.english: "Is building this station as important as fighting the Aberrant?"
units.italian: "Costruire questa stazione è importante quanto combattere l'Aberrante?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"Clarification. By no means do I begrudge the Assembly's decision. Without the Twilight Guard I would not be alive to complain about being paid to sit around all day, though that burden truly does pain me. But when I am asked by important delegates and electors why there is not yet an abundance of space with which to house their people, I am obliged to tell them that the decision rests with them, not with me."|562|0
units.english: "Clarification. By no means do I begrudge the Assembly's decision. Without the Twilight Guard I would not be alive to complain about being paid to sit around all day, though that burden truly does pain me. But when I am asked by important delegates and electors why there is not yet an abundance of space with which to house their people, I am obliged to tell them that the decision rests with them, not with me."
units.italian: "Chiarimento. Non biasimo affatto la decisione dell'Assemblea. Senza la Twilight Guard non sarei vivo per lamentarmi di essere pagato per stare seduto tutto il giorno, anche se quel peso mi duole davvero. Ma quando delegati ed elettori importanti mi chiedono perché non ci sia ancora abbondanza di spazio per ospitare la loro gente, sono obbligato a dire loro che la decisione spetta a loro, non a me."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"A Class Two rotating cylinder habitat. Unless you use the Hekkedian classification system, in which case it is a Type One orbital habitat station. Of course, the Freosi would call it a Lieno-Drareg Cylinder, but that name hasn't been fashionable in quite some time."|568|0
units.english: "A Class Two rotating cylinder habitat. Unless you use the Hekkedian classification system, in which case it is a Type One orbital habitat station. Of course, the Freosi would call it a Lieno-Drareg Cylinder, but that name hasn't been fashionable in quite some time."
units.italian: "Un cilindro abitativo rotante di Classe Due. A meno che tu non usi il sistema di classificazione Hekkedian, nel qual caso è una stazione abitativa orbitale di Tipo Uno. Certo, i Freosi lo chiamerebbero Cilindro Lieno-Drareg, ma quel nome non è più di moda da parecchio tempo."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"I was more asking about what it'll look like when it's done," you say.|569|0
units.english: "I was more asking about what it'll look like when it's done," you say.
units.italian: "Stavo più che altro chiedendo che aspetto avrà quando sarà finito," dici.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"Amusement. I know, I know, I was just messing with you." He gestures out the window towards the steel skeleton of the unfinished station. "Six kilometers wide and twelve long, with two-hundred-sixty-six ribs of nickel-iron roidsteel and ninety spinal columns of carbon nanofilament. Once the base frame is complete, and it very nearly is, we will begin plating it with sheets of aerogel and graphene, with a fluorinated polymer layer coating the inside. After that my job is done, and we hand the project over to the ecosystem engineers."|570|0
units.english: "Amusement. I know, I know, I was just messing with you." He gestures out the window towards the steel skeleton of the unfinished station. "Six kilometers wide and twelve long, with two-hundred-sixty-six ribs of nickel-iron roidsteel and ninety spinal columns of carbon nanofilament. Once the base frame is complete, and it very nearly is, we will begin plating it with sheets of aerogel and graphene, with a fluorinated polymer layer coating the inside. After that my job is done, and we hand the project over to the ecosystem engineers."
units.italian: "Divertimento. Lo so, lo so, ti stavo solo prendendo in giro." Fa un gesto verso la finestra, verso lo scheletro d'acciaio della stazione incompiuta. "Sei chilometri di larghezza e dodici di lunghezza, con duecentosei costole di acciaio asteroidale al nichel-ferro e novanta colonne spinali di nanofibra di carbonio. Una volta completata la struttura di base, e ci siamo quasi, cominceremo a rivestirla con fogli di aerogel e grafene, con uno strato di polimero fluorurato a ricoprire l'interno. Dopo di che il mio lavoro è finito, e passiamo il progetto agli ingegneri degli ecosistemi."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"What do they do?"|572|0
units.english: "What do they do?"
units.italian: "Che cosa fanno?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"That sounds like a lot."|574|0
units.english: "That sounds like a lot."
units.italian: "Sembra un lavoraccio."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"Appreciation. Oh, it is. Over seven hundred megatons of raw material, scraped off moons and torn from asteroids. But it will be worth it, in the end.|576|0
units.english: "Appreciation. Oh, it is. Over seven hundred megatons of raw material, scraped off moons and torn from asteroids. But it will be worth it, in the end.
units.italian: "Riconoscenza. Oh, lo è. Oltre settecento megatoni di materia prima, raschiata dalle lune e strappata agli asteroidi. Ma ne varrà la pena, alla fine.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"Of course, the entire purpose of this is to provide enough living space for the Avgi who escaped the Aberrant. And everyone would rather live in an open environment, instead of pretending a garden in a smaller station is sufficient. Thus, the ecosystem engineers come in with their millions of tons of soil to dirty up our nice shiny metal and nanofilaments, and grow grass and trees and fungus to make this place a little less dreary. I suppose we'll make most of the soil in bulk from crushed carbonaceous asteroids, and seed it with whatever samples we have from Aviskir."|579|0
units.english: "Of course, the entire purpose of this is to provide enough living space for the Avgi who escaped the Aberrant. And everyone would rather live in an open environment, instead of pretending a garden in a smaller station is sufficient. Thus, the ecosystem engineers come in with their millions of tons of soil to dirty up our nice shiny metal and nanofilaments, and grow grass and trees and fungus to make this place a little less dreary. I suppose we'll make most of the soil in bulk from crushed carbonaceous asteroids, and seed it with whatever samples we have from Aviskir."
units.italian: "Naturalmente, lo scopo di tutto questo è fornire spazio abitativo sufficiente agli Avgi fuggiti dall'Aberrante. E tutti preferirebbero vivere in un ambiente aperto, invece di fingere che un giardino in una stazione più piccola basti. Così arrivano gli ingegneri degli ecosistemi con i loro milioni di tonnellate di terra a sporcare il nostro bel metallo lucido e le nanofibre, e a far crescere erba, alberi e funghi per rendere questo posto un po' meno desolato. Suppongo che produrremo la maggior parte della terra in massa da asteroidi carbonacei frantumati, e la semineremo con i campioni che abbiamo di Aviskir."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"Consideration. A place to live, with enough space to be a real home, not just a temporary outpost with a few houseplants. You should know, we had thousands of cylinders far larger than this one back in Anax and around our other colonies. Billions of Avgi, housed not on planets but in space. This is but a pale imitation of what we once had, but it is needed all the same. Do you know the most pressing question faced by the Assembly?"|585|0
units.english: "Consideration. A place to live, with enough space to be a real home, not just a temporary outpost with a few houseplants. You should know, we had thousands of cylinders far larger than this one back in Anax and around our other colonies. Billions of Avgi, housed not on planets but in space. This is but a pale imitation of what we once had, but it is needed all the same. Do you know the most pressing question faced by the Assembly?"
units.italian: "Considerazione. Un posto dove vivere, con spazio sufficiente per essere una vera casa, non solo un avamposto temporaneo con qualche pianta da interno. Devi sapere che avevamo migliaia di cilindri molto più grandi di questo, ad Anax e intorno alle altre nostre colonie. Miliardi di Avgi, ospitati non su pianeti ma nello spazio. Questo è solo una pallida imitazione di ciò che avevamo, ma è comunque necessario. Sai qual è la questione più urgente che l'Assemblea deve affrontare?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"No."|587|0
units.english: "No."
units.italian: "No."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"What would that be?"|588|0
units.english: "What would that be?"
units.italian: "Quale sarebbe?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"Mild surprise. It is oft spoken of. The Assembly must decide the fate of the millions of Avgi in cryogenic storage, frozen during our evacuation to facilitate their transportation. A scarce few thousand are thawed every year, the best and brightest we can find among them woken to fight the Aberrant, all because we lack the food and living space to support the rest. This cylinder here, Aktina, could support them."|590|0
units.english: "Mild surprise. It is oft spoken of. The Assembly must decide the fate of the millions of Avgi in cryogenic storage, frozen during our evacuation to facilitate their transportation. A scarce few thousand are thawed every year, the best and brightest we can find among them woken to fight the Aberrant, all because we lack the food and living space to support the rest. This cylinder here, Aktina, could support them."
units.italian: "Lieve sorpresa. Se ne parla spesso. L'Assemblea deve decidere il destino dei milioni di Avgi in stoccaggio criogenico, congelati durante la nostra evacuazione per facilitarne il trasporto. Ogni anno ne vengono scongelati appena qualche migliaio, i migliori e i più brillanti che riusciamo a trovare, risvegliati per combattere l'Aberrante, tutto perché non abbiamo cibo e spazio abitativo per sostenere gli altri. Questo cilindro, Aktina, potrebbe ospitarli."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"Appreciation. I was happy to answer them. Though, if I might ask a favor?"|598|0
units.english: "Appreciation. I was happy to answer them. Though, if I might ask a favor?"
units.italian: "Riconoscenza. Sono stato felice di rispondere. Anche se, potrei chiederti un favore?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"Sure."|600|0
units.english: "Sure."
units.italian: "Certo."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"I don't have time for anything, sorry."|601|0
units.english: "I don't have time for anything, sorry."
units.italian: "Non ho tempo per nulla, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"I hope I have impressed the importance of this project upon you. But, despite the scale of the resources required to truly complete it, we do not need an unreasonable amount to continue construction on the most essential elements. As a starship captain, independent of the requisitions and allocations of the Consonance, would you be willing to assist us in gathering the materials we need?"|604|0
units.english: "I hope I have impressed the importance of this project upon you. But, despite the scale of the resources required to truly complete it, we do not need an unreasonable amount to continue construction on the most essential elements. As a starship captain, independent of the requisitions and allocations of the Consonance, would you be willing to assist us in gathering the materials we need?"
units.italian: "Spero di averti trasmesso l'importanza di questo progetto. Ma, nonostante la scala delle risorse necessarie a completarlo davvero, non ci serve una quantità irragionevole per continuare la costruzione negli elementi più essenziali. Come capitano di nave stellare, indipendente dalle requisizioni e dalle assegnazioni della Consonanza, saresti disposto ad aiutarci a raccogliere i materiali che ci servono?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"Yes."|606|0
units.english: "Yes."
units.italian: "Sì."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"For the right pay."|607|0
units.english: "For the right pay."
units.italian: "Per una paga adeguata."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"Sorry, no."|608|0
units.english: "Sorry, no."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, no."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Cylinder Construction|	"Gratitude. I will ensure there are items posted on nearby job boards that you might gather and transport here."|613|0
units.english: "Gratitude. I will ensure there are items posted on nearby job boards that you might gather and transport here."
units.italian: "Gratitudine. Farò in modo che ci siano oggetti pubblicati sulle bacheche degli incarichi qui intorno che tu possa raccogliere e trasportare qui."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|log|625|0
units.english: Hansa is an Infocourier, a role that sees him transport files and records between systems in a small ship. As the Avgi never developed hyperspace comms, courier ships are necessary to communicate across interstellar distances.
units.italian: Hansa è un infocorriere, un ruolo che lo vede trasportare file e registri tra i sistemi su una piccola nave. Poiché gli Avgi non hanno mai sviluppato comunicazioni iperspaziali, le navi corriere sono necessarie per comunicare attraverso distanze interstellari.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|While admiring the ships in <origin>'s spaceport, you notice a Polari painted in civilian Avgi colors, rather than usual deep blue of the Twilight Guard. All of the scouts you've seen before have been commissioned ships of the Guard, but it seems like this one might be privately owned.|627|0
units.english: While admiring the ships in <origin>'s spaceport, you notice a Polari painted in civilian Avgi colors, rather than usual deep blue of the Twilight Guard. All of the scouts you've seen before have been commissioned ships of the Guard, but it seems like this one might be privately owned.
units.italian: Mentre ammiri le navi nello spazioporto di <origin>, noti una Polari dipinta con i colori civili Avgi, invece del solito blu scuro della Twilight Guard. Tutte le esploratrici che hai visto prima erano navi in servizio della Guardia, ma questa sembra di proprietà privata.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	(Ask around about who the Polari belongs to.)|629|0
units.english: (Ask around about who the Polari belongs to.)
units.italian: (Chiedi in giro di chi sia la Polari.)

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	(It's not that interesting. I have better things to do.)|630|0
units.english: (It's not that interesting. I have better things to do.)
units.italian: (Non è così interessante. Ho cose migliori da fare.)

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	You ask a few passing Avgi, and eventually one is able to answer your question.|633|0
units.english: You ask a few passing Avgi, and eventually one is able to answer your question.
units.italian: Chiedi a qualche Avgi di passaggio, e alla fine uno riesce a rispondere alla tua domanda.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	"Probably an infocourier ship, hauling information and databases instead of cargo. The Guard sometimes sends ships to market if they've taken a beating and aren't worth fixing up to combat standards, which is probably what happened there."|634|0
units.english: "Probably an infocourier ship, hauling information and databases instead of cargo. The Guard sometimes sends ships to market if they've taken a beating and aren't worth fixing up to combat standards, which is probably what happened there."
units.italian: "Probabilmente una nave infocorriere, che trasporta informazioni e banche dati invece di carichi. La Guardia a volte manda le navi sul mercato quando sono ridotte male e non valgono la pena di essere riportate agli standard di combattimento, ed è probabilmente quello che è successo qui."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	You thank the Avgi for their time, and are about to leave when you spot a pale yellow Avgi climbing on board the exact ship you've been talking about. You might as well see if he's willing to chat.|635|0
units.english: You thank the Avgi for their time, and are about to leave when you spot a pale yellow Avgi climbing on board the exact ship you've been talking about. You might as well see if he's willing to chat.
units.italian: Ringrazi l'Avgi per il tempo e stai per andartene quando scorgi un Avgi giallo pallido che sale proprio sulla nave di cui stavate parlando. Tanto vale vedere se ha voglia di chiacchierare.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	"Hey, do you have a moment?" you ask as you jog over.|636|0
units.english: "Hey, do you have a moment?" you ask as you jog over.
units.italian: "Ehi, hai un momento?" chiedi, avvicinandoti di corsa.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	The Avgi looks down from atop the Polari. "Invitation, I do. The name's Hansa, and you are?"|637|0
units.english: The Avgi looks down from atop the Polari. "Invitation, I do. The name's Hansa, and you are?"
units.italian: L'Avgi guarda giù dalla cima della Polari. "Invito, ce l'ho. Mi chiamo Hansa, e tu?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	"Captain <first> <last>," you say. "Are you one of the infocouriers?"|638|0
units.english: "Captain <first> <last>," you say. "Are you one of the infocouriers?"
units.italian: "Capitano <first> <last>," dici. "Sei uno degli infocorrieri?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	Hansa clicks his arms together. "Mild surprise. Indeed I am, but I'm surprised you've heard of us. Not a lot of people talk about the courier system these days."|641|0
units.english: Hansa clicks his arms together. "Mild surprise. Indeed I am, but I'm surprised you've heard of us. Not a lot of people talk about the courier system these days."
units.italian: Hansa fa scattare i bracci uno contro l'altro. "Lieve sorpresa. Lo sono davvero, ma mi sorprende che tu abbia sentito parlare di noi. Non molta gente parla del sistema dei corrieri, di questi tempi."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	"Why is that?"|643|0
units.english: "Why is that?"
units.italian: "Come mai?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	"What do couriers do?"|644|0
units.english: "What do couriers do?"
units.italian: "Che cosa fanno i corrieri?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	"Hmm. Consideration. Decades ago, before the hyperdrive, the arrival of an interstellar courier ship would be a cause for celeberation. Entire planets would rejoice to receive news of the sciences and arts of other stars, which were cherished. You see, interstellar visits were rare during those days, only a few times a year at most. There was remote communication, of course, with bright x-ray lasers and telescopes to receive them, but the transfer rates were too slow for information to be shared in bulk."|647|0
units.english: "Hmm. Consideration. Decades ago, before the hyperdrive, the arrival of an interstellar courier ship would be a cause for celeberation. Entire planets would rejoice to receive news of the sciences and arts of other stars, which were cherished. You see, interstellar visits were rare during those days, only a few times a year at most. There was remote communication, of course, with bright x-ray lasers and telescopes to receive them, but the transfer rates were too slow for information to be shared in bulk."
units.italian: "Hmm. Considerazione. Decenni fa, prima dell'hyperdrive, l'arrivo di una nave corriere interstellare era motivo di celebrazione. Interi pianeti gioivano nel ricevere notizie delle scienze e delle arti di altre stelle, che erano tenute care. Vedi, le visite interstellari erano rare in quei giorni, al massimo qualche volta l'anno. C'era la comunicazione a distanza, naturalmente, con luminosi laser a raggi X e telescopi per riceverli, ma i tassi di trasferimento erano troppo lenti perché l'informazione potesse essere condivisa in massa."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	Hansa flicks his wings. "A good courier ship might have been less than half as fast as a laser operating at the speed of light, but it could move a thousandfold more information in the same time nonetheless. And a courier ship could carry all the information produced by an entire system's worth of people in a decade, and share it with the neighboring systems so they could update their own databases. Those were the days," he says wistfully.|648|0
units.english: Hansa flicks his wings. "A good courier ship might have been less than half as fast as a laser operating at the speed of light, but it could move a thousandfold more information in the same time nonetheless. And a courier ship could carry all the information produced by an entire system's worth of people in a decade, and share it with the neighboring systems so they could update their own databases. Those were the days," he says wistfully.
units.italian: Hansa agita le ali. "Una buona nave corriere poteva essere meno di metà veloce di un laser che viaggia alla velocità della luce, ma poteva comunque spostare mille volte più informazione nello stesso tempo. E una nave corriere poteva portare tutta l'informazione prodotta da un intero sistema di persone in un decennio, e condividerla con i sistemi vicini perché potessero aggiornare le proprie banche dati. Quelli sì che erano giorni," dice con nostalgia.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	"What changed?"|650|0
units.english: "What changed?"
units.italian: "Che cosa è cambiato?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	Hansa sighs, making an odd whistling sound. "Nostalgia. Interstellar travel is much easier these days. Gone are the kilometer-long starships, the petawatt beam-pushers. I'm not complaining about it, of course - it is impossible to overstate just how incredible the hyperdrive has been. Now that interstellar journeys take days instead of decades, the courier system has adapted, and now it is just that - a system. Regular. Predictable. And ultimately unexciting." He looks a bit dejected.|652|0
units.english: Hansa sighs, making an odd whistling sound. "Nostalgia. Interstellar travel is much easier these days. Gone are the kilometer-long starships, the petawatt beam-pushers. I'm not complaining about it, of course - it is impossible to overstate just how incredible the hyperdrive has been. Now that interstellar journeys take days instead of decades, the courier system has adapted, and now it is just that - a system. Regular. Predictable. And ultimately unexciting." He looks a bit dejected.
units.italian: Hansa sospira, emettendo uno strano suono fischiante. "Nostalgia. I viaggi interstellari sono molto più facili, oggi. Sono finiti i tempi delle navi stellari lunghe un chilometro, dei propulsori a fascio da petawatt. Non me ne lamento, naturalmente: è impossibile esagerare quanto sia stato incredibile l'hyperdrive. Ora che i viaggi interstellari richiedono giorni invece di decenni, il sistema dei corrieri si è adattato, e ora è solo questo: un sistema. Regolare. Prevedibile. E alla fine poco emozionante." Sembra un po' abbattuto.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	"Today, we make the rounds in ships that are fast, but have the room for enough storage media to update a planet's entire network. In our heyday, before the Incursion, a courier ship would visit a world every day to upload its database, but since then we've struggled to keep each system controlled by the Consonance updated once per week."|654|0
units.english: "Today, we make the rounds in ships that are fast, but have the room for enough storage media to update a planet's entire network. In our heyday, before the Incursion, a courier ship would visit a world every day to upload its database, but since then we've struggled to keep each system controlled by the Consonance updated once per week."
units.italian: "Oggi facciamo i giri con navi veloci, ma con lo spazio per abbastanza supporti di memoria da aggiornare l'intera rete di un pianeta. Ai nostri tempi d'oro, prima dell'Incursione, una nave corriere visitava un mondo ogni giorno per caricare la sua banca dati, ma da allora fatichiamo a mantenere ogni sistema controllato dalla Consonanza aggiornato una volta alla settimana."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	"Why use a Polari? Aren't those scout ships?"|657|0
units.english: "Why use a Polari? Aren't those scout ships?"
units.italian: "Perché usare una Polari? Non sono navi esploratrici?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	"How can you update an entire planetary network with one courier ship?"|658|0
units.english: "How can you update an entire planetary network with one courier ship?"
units.italian: "Come si fa ad aggiornare l'intera rete di un pianeta con una sola nave corriere?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	"Sounds like an interesting job. Is there any way I could take infocourier missions?"|660|0
units.english: "Sounds like an interesting job. Is there any way I could take infocourier missions?"
units.italian: "Sembra un lavoro interessante. C'è un modo per cui possa prendere missioni da infocorriere?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	"Consideration. Many reasons, some of which are even good ones. Mostly because what makes them excellent research and scout vessels also makes them excellent courier ships - fast, while also having large integrated memory banks and a reasonable amount of space for cargo. It helps that the Twilight Guard has been decommissioning so many Polari lately, with how fragile they are against the Aberrant. Anticipation. It wouldn't surprise me if they designed a successor to them, if you ask me."|663|0
units.english: "Consideration. Many reasons, some of which are even good ones. Mostly because what makes them excellent research and scout vessels also makes them excellent courier ships - fast, while also having large integrated memory banks and a reasonable amount of space for cargo. It helps that the Twilight Guard has been decommissioning so many Polari lately, with how fragile they are against the Aberrant. Anticipation. It wouldn't surprise me if they designed a successor to them, if you ask me."
units.italian: "Considerazione. Molte ragioni, alcune delle quali persino buone. Soprattutto perché ciò che le rende ottime navi da ricerca ed esplorazione le rende anche ottime navi corriere: veloci, e con grandi banche di memoria integrate e uno spazio ragionevole per il carico. Aiuta che la Twilight Guard ne stia dismettendo tante, di Polari, ultimamente, per quanto siano fragili contro l'Aberrante. Anticipazione. Non mi sorprenderebbe se ne progettassero una successiva, se me lo chiedi."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	"Explanation. Incredibly dense storage media, of course: memory diamond, we call it. You can find it under a dozen trade names, each claiming to be better than the last, but they're really all the same stuff, more or less. Chains of alternating carbon-12 and carbon-13, printed out as a diamond by specialized nanofabricators. The stuff is incredibly resilient, chemically stable, and will keep information archived practically forever. Just keep it away from radiation and high heat, which diamond doesn't stand up to well."|667|0
units.english: "Explanation. Incredibly dense storage media, of course: memory diamond, we call it. You can find it under a dozen trade names, each claiming to be better than the last, but they're really all the same stuff, more or less. Chains of alternating carbon-12 and carbon-13, printed out as a diamond by specialized nanofabricators. The stuff is incredibly resilient, chemically stable, and will keep information archived practically forever. Just keep it away from radiation and high heat, which diamond doesn't stand up to well."
units.italian: "Spiegazione. Supporti di memoria incredibilmente densi, naturalmente: diamante di memoria, lo chiamiamo. Lo trovi sotto una dozzina di nomi commerciali, ognuno che dichiara di essere migliore del precedente, ma in realtà sono tutti più o meno la stessa cosa. Catene di carbonio-12 e carbonio-13 alternati, stampate come diamante da nanofabbricatori specializzati. Il materiale è incredibilmente resistente, chimicamente stabile, e conserva le informazioni in archivio praticamente per sempre. Tienilo solo lontano da radiazioni e calore elevato, che il diamante non sopporta bene."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	He twitches his wings. "Amusement. Of course, don't be expecting data crystals or glowing gemstones like you see in science fiction. Most of the time it comes in matte black bricks or slabs, nothing flashy."|668|0
units.english: He twitches his wings. "Amusement. Of course, don't be expecting data crystals or glowing gemstones like you see in science fiction. Most of the time it comes in matte black bricks or slabs, nothing flashy."
units.italian: Agita le ali. "Divertimento. Naturalmente, non aspettarti cristalli di dati o gemme luminose come nei romanzi di fantascienza. Il più delle volte arriva in mattoni o lastre nero opaco, niente di appariscente."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	"Consideration. With a fast ship, anyone trusted enough to haul a few dozen tons of memory diamond can do the job. In fact, I can make a few calls and see about expediting the process for you, if you'd like."|672|0
units.english: "Consideration. With a fast ship, anyone trusted enough to haul a few dozen tons of memory diamond can do the job. In fact, I can make a few calls and see about expediting the process for you, if you'd like."
units.italian: "Considerazione. Con una nave veloce, chiunque sia abbastanza affidabile da trasportare qualche dozzina di tonnellate di diamante di memoria può fare il lavoro. Anzi, posso fare qualche chiamata e vedere di accelerare la pratica per te, se vuoi."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	"Yes, I'd like that."|674|0
units.english: "Yes, I'd like that."
units.italian: "Sì, mi piacerebbe."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	"How much are you normally paid for ferrying information?"|676|0
units.english: "How much are you normally paid for ferrying information?"
units.italian: "Quanto vi pagano normalmente per trasportare informazioni?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	Hansa laughs. "Too much, if you ask anyone else. The Assembly recognizes how critical it is to maintain lines of communication, especially now, with the War, so we haven't suffered nearly as much as most. Amusement. It would be rare indeed to find a captain that would turn down a courier job, but a ship has to be fast and willing to drop everything to rush to a particular system as often as possible, with little time for breaks. Does that sound like the kind of job for you?"|678|0
units.english: Hansa laughs. "Too much, if you ask anyone else. The Assembly recognizes how critical it is to maintain lines of communication, especially now, with the War, so we haven't suffered nearly as much as most. Amusement. It would be rare indeed to find a captain that would turn down a courier job, but a ship has to be fast and willing to drop everything to rush to a particular system as often as possible, with little time for breaks. Does that sound like the kind of job for you?"
units.italian: Hansa ride. "Troppo, se chiedi a chiunque altro. L'Assemblea riconosce quanto sia cruciale mantenere le linee di comunicazione, soprattutto ora, con la Guerra, quindi non abbiamo sofferto quanto la maggior parte. Divertimento. Sarebbe davvero raro trovare un capitano che rifiuti un lavoro da corriere, ma una nave deve essere veloce e disposta a lasciare tutto per correre verso un sistema particolare il più spesso possibile, con poco tempo per le pause. Ti sembra il genere di lavoro per te?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	"I think I'm interested."|680|0
units.english: "I think I'm interested."
units.italian: "Credo di essere interessato."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	"Not really."|682|0
units.english: "Not really."
units.italian: "Non proprio."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	"Sympathy. I understand, it's not the easiest work around, nor the most exciting for someone with their own starship, which is why it can be so hard to find enough couriers to keep the system running."|684|0
units.english: "Sympathy. I understand, it's not the easiest work around, nor the most exciting for someone with their own starship, which is why it can be so hard to find enough couriers to keep the system running."
units.italian: "Comprensione. Capisco, non è il lavoro più facile che ci sia, né il più emozionante per chi ha una propria nave stellare, ed è per questo che può essere così difficile trovare abbastanza corrieri per mandare avanti il sistema."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Infocourier Encounter|	"Enthusiasm. I'm glad to hear that, there aren't nearly enough couriers plying the starways. I'll have your name passed along, and you should see offers to begin hauling media on the job board within a few days."|689|0
units.english: "Enthusiasm. I'm glad to hear that, there aren't nearly enough couriers plying the starways. I'll have your name passed along, and you should see offers to begin hauling media on the job board within a few days."
units.italian: "Entusiasmo. Sono lieto di sentirlo, non ci sono affatto abbastanza corrieri sulle vie stellari. Farò passare il tuo nome, e dovresti vedere offerte per iniziare a trasportare supporti sulla bacheca degli incarichi entro pochi giorni."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|log|701|0
units.english: Claret is a member of the Twilight Guard, curious about humans and passionate about the details of tactical space combat.
units.italian: Claret è un membro della Twilight Guard, curiosa riguardo agli umani e appassionata dei dettagli del combattimento spaziale tattico.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|You find yourself wandering into what looks like the Avgi version of a spaceport bar. A circular ampitheatre provides seating and tables around the dance floor, with drinks served at a long raised bar that curves around the rim of the room. Curious, you get in line, attracting more than a few interested stares from the aliens, until you reach the bar.|703|0
units.english: You find yourself wandering into what looks like the Avgi version of a spaceport bar. A circular ampitheatre provides seating and tables around the dance floor, with drinks served at a long raised bar that curves around the rim of the room. Curious, you get in line, attracting more than a few interested stares from the aliens, until you reach the bar.
units.italian: Ti ritrovi a vagare in quello che sembra l'equivalente Avgi di un bar da spazioporto. Un anfiteatro circolare offre posti a sedere e tavoli intorno alla pista da ballo, con bevande servite a un lungo bancone rialzato che curva lungo il bordo della sala. Incuriosito, ti metti in fila, attirando più di qualche sguardo interessato dagli alieni, finché non arrivi al bancone.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Hey you, want a drink, question?" the bartender asks with a wave, your translator receiving the musical tone. You look behind him, expecting shelves of bottles or barrels, but instead the space behind the bar looks more like a greenhouse, with rows of colorful flowers and plants growing in troughs under blue-violet lights.|704|0
units.english: "Hey you, want a drink, question?" the bartender asks with a wave, your translator receiving the musical tone. You look behind him, expecting shelves of bottles or barrels, but instead the space behind the bar looks more like a greenhouse, with rows of colorful flowers and plants growing in troughs under blue-violet lights.
units.italian: "Ehi tu, vuoi da bere, domanda?" chiede il barista con un cenno, e il tuo traduttore riceve il tono musicale. Guardi dietro di lui, aspettandoti scaffali di bottiglie o botti, ma lo spazio dietro il bancone somiglia più a una serra, con file di fiori e piante colorate che crescono in vasche sotto luci blu-viola.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Is this stuff safe for humans?" you ask.|705|0
units.english: "Is this stuff safe for humans?" you ask.
units.italian: "Questa roba è sicura per gli umani?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	The bartender splays his arms in what might be a shrug. "Nonchalance. Who knows? Anyway, you want a drink or not?"|706|0
units.english: The bartender splays his arms in what might be a shrug. "Nonchalance. Who knows? Anyway, you want a drink or not?"
units.italian: Il barista apre i bracci in quella che potrebbe essere un'alzata di spalle. "Noncuranza. Chi lo sa? Comunque, vuoi da bere o no?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|"I'll pass."|708|0
units.english: "I'll pass."
units.italian: "Passo."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|"Sure. What would you recommend?"|710|0
units.english: "Sure. What would you recommend?"
units.italian: "Certo. Che cosa mi consigli?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	He gives you a look. "Amusement. You're no regular so I'll start you off with a Quis Nectar. On the house." He turns around, deftly snatching up something close to a cocktail glass, and pulls out a big, dangerous-looking glass pipette from somewhere under the bar. Smoothly dipping it into something that looks like a large pitcher plant, he draws out a clear, slightly pink-tinged liquid before depositing it in the glass. "Enjoy, amusement."|712|0
units.english: He gives you a look. "Amusement. You're no regular so I'll start you off with a Quis Nectar. On the house." He turns around, deftly snatching up something close to a cocktail glass, and pulls out a big, dangerous-looking glass pipette from somewhere under the bar. Smoothly dipping it into something that looks like a large pitcher plant, he draws out a clear, slightly pink-tinged liquid before depositing it in the glass. "Enjoy, amusement."
units.italian: Ti lancia uno sguardo. "Divertimento. Non sei un cliente abituale, quindi comincio con un Nettare Quis. Offre la casa." Si volta, afferra abilmente qualcosa che somiglia a un bicchiere da cocktail, e tira fuori da qualche parte sotto il bancone una grande pipetta di vetro dall'aria pericolosa. La immerge con fluidità in qualcosa che sembra una grande pianta carnivora, ne estrae un liquido limpido, leggermente rosato, e lo versa nel bicchiere. "Goditelo, divertimento."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	(Gulp it down.) "Bottoms up."|714|0
units.english: (Gulp it down.) "Bottoms up."
units.italian: (Mandalo giù tutto.) "Salute."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	(Take a sip.) "Thanks."|716|0
units.english: (Take a sip.) "Thanks."
units.italian: (Prendi un sorso.) "Grazie."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	The liquid is pleasantly light and sweet, with a bit of bitterness behind it. It doesn't taste anything like alcohol, but you can feel the lights in the room become a little sharper and brighter.|718|0
units.english: The liquid is pleasantly light and sweet, with a bit of bitterness behind it. It doesn't taste anything like alcohol, but you can feel the lights in the room become a little sharper and brighter.
units.italian: Il liquido è piacevolmente leggero e dolce, con un po' di amaro sullo sfondo. Non ha affatto sapore di alcol, ma senti che le luci della sala diventano un po' più nitide e luminose.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|label|721|0
units.english: too much
units.italian: too much

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	You toss back your glass in a swift movement, swallowing the alien liquid in one smooth gulp. It's pleasantly light, and quite sweet. You can't taste any alcohol, but the room seems to light up as every detail becomes crisp and defined.|722|0
units.english: You toss back your glass in a swift movement, swallowing the alien liquid in one smooth gulp. It's pleasantly light, and quite sweet. You can't taste any alcohol, but the room seems to light up as every detail becomes crisp and defined.
units.italian: Butti giù il bicchiere con un movimento rapido, ingoiando il liquido alieno in un sorso fluido. È piacevolmente leggero e piuttosto dolce. Non senti alcun sapore di alcol, ma la sala sembra illuminarsi mentre ogni dettaglio diventa nitido e definito.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	Another bar patron sidles up next to you. "Hey, you must be one of those aliens, right, question?" The Avgi is a warm, wine-red color, matching the color of her drink.|725|0
units.english: Another bar patron sidles up next to you. "Hey, you must be one of those aliens, right, question?" The Avgi is a warm, wine-red color, matching the color of her drink.
units.italian: Un altro cliente del bar ti si accosta. "Ehi, devi essere uno di quegli alieni, vero, domanda?" L'Avgi è di un caldo color rosso vino, in tinta con la sua bevanda.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Yep, that's me. How'd you know?"|727|0
units.english: "Yep, that's me. How'd you know?"
units.italian: "Sì, sono io. Come lo sai?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"No, you must have had a bit too much to drink."|729|0
units.english: "No, you must have had a bit too much to drink."
units.italian: "No, devi aver bevuto un po' troppo."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Unamused. Very funny, but I'm not quite that wired."|730|0
units.english: "Unamused. Very funny, but I'm not quite that wired."
units.italian: "Poco divertito. Molto spiritoso, ma non sono così su di giri."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Amusement. That was rhetorical." She takes a sip from her own drink.|734|0
units.english: "Amusement. That was rhetorical." She takes a sip from her own drink.
units.italian: "Divertimento. Era retorico." Prende un sorso dalla propria bevanda.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"The name's Claret." She extends an arm, which you reach out to shake, but she instead taps her forearm to yours. "You're a hot topic among the Guard, you know?" She peers at you with inscrutable compound eyes.|739|0
units.english: "The name's Claret." She extends an arm, which you reach out to shake, but she instead taps her forearm to yours. "You're a hot topic among the Guard, you know?" She peers at you with inscrutable compound eyes.
units.italian: "Mi chiamo Claret." Allunga un braccio, che tu tendi la mano per stringere, ma lei invece batte l'avambraccio contro il tuo. "Sei un argomento caldo tra la Guardia, sai?" Ti scruta con occhi composti imperscrutabili.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"The Guard?"|741|0
units.english: "The Guard?"
units.italian: "La Guardia?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Why is that?"|742|0
units.english: "Why is that?"
units.italian: "Come mai?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	Claret flares her wings out and raises her arms in an exaggerated pose. "Inflated boast. The Twilight Guard. You know, us brave warriors that are the last line of defense between the murderous Aberrant and the last bastion of Avgi civilization. Well, except for the people stuck back on Aviskir, but we don't talk about that, heh." She waves an arm. "But back to you, Captain <last>."|745|0
units.english: Claret flares her wings out and raises her arms in an exaggerated pose. "Inflated boast. The Twilight Guard. You know, us brave warriors that are the last line of defense between the murderous Aberrant and the last bastion of Avgi civilization. Well, except for the people stuck back on Aviskir, but we don't talk about that, heh." She waves an arm. "But back to you, Captain <last>."
units.italian: Claret apre le ali e alza le braccia in una posa esagerata. "Vanto gonfiato. La Twilight Guard. Sai, noi coraggiosi guerrieri che siamo l'ultima linea di difesa tra l'Aberrante omicida e l'ultimo bastione della civiltà Avgi. Beh, a parte la gente rimasta su Aviskir, ma di quella non parliamo, eh." Agita un braccio. "Ma torniamo a te, capitano <last>."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	She points at you dramatically. "You're an alien, and you fought the Aberrant. Even though we've seen a few of you people around, none of them have flown a starship quite like yours. Of course we've been talking about you. Wouldn't surprise me if half the Consonance was, really."|748|0
units.english: She points at you dramatically. "You're an alien, and you fought the Aberrant. Even though we've seen a few of you people around, none of them have flown a starship quite like yours. Of course we've been talking about you. Wouldn't surprise me if half the Consonance was, really."
units.italian: Ti indica in modo drammatico. "Sei un alieno, e hai combattuto l'Aberrante. Anche se abbiamo visto qualcuno di voi in giro, nessuno di loro pilotava una nave stellare come la tua. Certo che abbiamo parlato di te. Non mi sorprenderebbe se metà della Consonanza lo stesse facendo, davvero."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Well, what do they say about me?|750|0
units.english: "Well, what do they say about me?
units.italian: "Beh, che cosa dicono di me?

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"All good things, I hope."|752|0
units.english: "All good things, I hope."
units.italian: "Tutto bene, spero."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Dismissive. Of course, everyone is singing your praises. Except for the ones who claim you aren't one of those 'humans' at all, and are secretly an Aberrant in the shape of one waiting for the perfect moment to strike and eat our children." Claret gives you a serious look. "You aren't, right?"|754|0
units.english: "Dismissive. Of course, everyone is singing your praises. Except for the ones who claim you aren't one of those 'humans' at all, and are secretly an Aberrant in the shape of one waiting for the perfect moment to strike and eat our children." Claret gives you a serious look. "You aren't, right?"
units.italian: "Sdegnoso. Certo, tutti cantano le tue lodi. Tranne quelli che sostengono che tu non sia affatto uno di quegli 'umani', e che sia in segreto un Aberrante con le loro sembianze, in attesa del momento perfetto per colpire e mangiare i nostri figli." Claret ti lancia uno sguardo serio. "Non lo sei, vero?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Not last I checked."|756|0
units.english: "Not last I checked."
units.italian: "Non per quanto ne so."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Nope."|758|0
units.english: "Nope."
units.italian: "Macché."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Well, you've caught me."|760|0
units.english: "Well, you've caught me."
units.italian: "Beh, mi hai scoperto."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Oh no." she says in a completely flat voice. "I am absolutely terrified." She takes a deep drink before sighing contentedly.|762|0
units.english: "Oh no." she says in a completely flat voice. "I am absolutely terrified." She takes a deep drink before sighing contentedly.
units.italian: "Oh no," dice con voce del tutto piatta. "Sono assolutamente terrorizzata." Beve un sorso profondo prima di sospirare soddisfatta.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Some say that the humans will soon arrive to save us with their superior technology. Others say you'll be the next aliens to invade us, and finish the job the Aberrant started."|765|0
units.english: "Some say that the humans will soon arrive to save us with their superior technology. Others say you'll be the next aliens to invade us, and finish the job the Aberrant started."
units.italian: "Alcuni dicono che gli umani arriveranno presto a salvarci con la loro tecnologia superiore. Altri dicono che sarete i prossimi alieni a invaderci, e a finire il lavoro che l'Aberrante ha cominciato."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"And which do you believe?"|767|0
units.english: "And which do you believe?"
units.italian: "E tu a cosa credi?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Very contradictory rumors."|769|0
units.english: "Very contradictory rumors."
units.italian: "Voci molto contraddittorie."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	She gives you an incredulous look. "Scorn. When are they not? I don't know about you humans, but ask three Avgi the same question and you'll get six different answers. We are a fractious lot, us Avgi, and that will be true until the stars burn out and the moons fall from the sky.|771|0
units.english: She gives you an incredulous look. "Scorn. When are they not? I don't know about you humans, but ask three Avgi the same question and you'll get six different answers. We are a fractious lot, us Avgi, and that will be true until the stars burn out and the moons fall from the sky.
units.italian: Ti lancia uno sguardo incredulo. "Disprezzo. Quando mai non lo sono? Non so da voi umani, ma chiedi la stessa cosa a tre Avgi e otterrai sei risposte diverse. Siamo un branco rissoso, noi Avgi, e lo saremo finché le stelle non si spegneranno e le lune non cadranno dal cielo.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Amusement. Neither. Either one would be too easy, and that of course can't be allowed, not in this universe. I expect your Republic would spend years and years debating whether to even acknowledge our existence, let alone take any kind of action."|775|0
units.english: "Amusement. Neither. Either one would be too easy, and that of course can't be allowed, not in this universe. I expect your Republic would spend years and years debating whether to even acknowledge our existence, let alone take any kind of action."
units.italian: "Divertimento. Nessuna delle due. L'una o l'altra sarebbe troppo facile, e questo naturalmente non può essere permesso, non in questo universo. Mi aspetto che la vostra Repubblica passerebbe anni e anni a dibattere se persino riconoscere la nostra esistenza, figurarsi agire in qualche modo."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"You don't give the Republic enough credit. Parliament can be decisive when it needs to be."|777|0
units.english: "You don't give the Republic enough credit. Parliament can be decisive when it needs to be."
units.italian: "Non dai abbastanza credito alla Repubblica. Il Parlamento sa essere deciso quando serve."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Parliament might be slow, but the Navy is full of good people who would help if they could."|778|0
units.english: "Parliament might be slow, but the Navy is full of good people who would help if they could."
units.italian: "Il Parlamento sarà lento, ma la Marina è piena di brava gente che aiuterebbe, se potesse."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"That's a surprisingly accurate estimation of the Republic."|779|0
units.english: "That's a surprisingly accurate estimation of the Republic."
units.italian: "È una stima della Repubblica sorprendentemente accurata."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Maybe, but there are others that would try to exploit you. That's just human nature."|781|0
units.english: "Maybe, but there are others that would try to exploit you. That's just human nature."
units.italian: "Forse, ma ci sono altri che cercherebbero di sfruttarvi. È la natura umana."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Well, the Republic isn't the only government in human space these days. The Free Worlds might try to help you."|783|0
units.english: "Well, the Republic isn't the only government in human space these days. The Free Worlds might try to help you."
units.italian: "Beh, la Repubblica non è l'unico governo nello spazio umano, di questi tempi. I Free Worlds potrebbero provare ad aiutarvi."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Perhaps. I wouldn't hold out hope, though. Like I said, it would be too easy, either if you were out to get us or in to save us. And I don't know how you would fare against the Aberrant either - they might even invade you too, if they could. Your technology may be better than ours, but I've heard quiet rumors it's not that much better, certainly not as good as what the Aberrant use.|787|0
units.english: "Perhaps. I wouldn't hold out hope, though. Like I said, it would be too easy, either if you were out to get us or in to save us. And I don't know how you would fare against the Aberrant either - they might even invade you too, if they could. Your technology may be better than ours, but I've heard quiet rumors it's not that much better, certainly not as good as what the Aberrant use.
units.italian: "Forse. Non ci farei affidamento, però. Come ho detto, sarebbe troppo facile, sia che voi foste qui per darci la caccia sia per salvarci. E non so nemmeno come ve la cavereste contro l'Aberrante: potrebbero persino invadere anche voi, se potessero. La vostra tecnologia sarà migliore della nostra, ma ho sentito voci sommesse che non è poi molto migliore, di certo non buona come quella che usa l'Aberrante.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Perhaps. But I don't think so, not from what I've seen of you. Your stranded fellows, they dedicated themselves to helping us as soon as they realized they couldn't go home. I didn't like that short fellow though, all he did was complain." She smirks. "Reminded me of an ensign back in school.|791|0
units.english: "Perhaps. But I don't think so, not from what I've seen of you. Your stranded fellows, they dedicated themselves to helping us as soon as they realized they couldn't go home. I didn't like that short fellow though, all he did was complain." She smirks. "Reminded me of an ensign back in school.
units.italian: "Forse. Ma non credo, non da quello che ho visto di voi. I vostri compagni bloccati, si sono dedicati ad aiutarci appena hanno capito che non potevano tornare a casa. Quel tizio basso però non mi piaceva, faceva solo lamentarsi." Sorride con sufficienza. "Mi ricordava un guardiamarina dei tempi della scuola.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"You humans aren't too different from us then." She looks thoughtful. "Maybe that would help us get along, your Republic and our Consonance bonding over shared bureaucratic torment. Might even be able to work together and invent something even worse." Claret shudders.|795|0
units.english: "You humans aren't too different from us then." She looks thoughtful. "Maybe that would help us get along, your Republic and our Consonance bonding over shared bureaucratic torment. Might even be able to work together and invent something even worse." Claret shudders.
units.italian: "Voi umani non siete molto diversi da noi, allora." Sembra pensierosa. "Forse ci aiuterebbe ad andare d'accordo, la vostra Repubblica e la nostra Consonanza che si uniscono su un comune tormento burocratico. Potremmo persino riuscire a collaborare e a inventare qualcosa di ancora peggiore." Claret rabbrividisce.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"But aside from that, you humans are a true delight. I met your Captain Darius and he regaled me with many stories of your own Navy. Your Carriers sound especially fearsome."|799|0
units.english: "But aside from that, you humans are a true delight. I met your Captain Darius and he regaled me with many stories of your own Navy. Your Carriers sound especially fearsome."
units.italian: "Ma a parte questo, voi umani siete una vera delizia. Ho conosciuto il vostro capitano Darius, che mi ha deliziato con molte storie della vostra Marina. Le vostre Portaerei suonano particolarmente temibili."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Yes, they are."|801|0
units.english: "Yes, they are."
units.italian: "Sì, lo sono."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Eh, they're not so strong. I've faced a few."|802|0
units.english: "Eh, they're not so strong. I've faced a few."
units.italian: "Eh, non sono poi così forti. Ne ho affrontate un paio."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Modest, aren't we, amusement." she says. "Captain Darius told me much about the weapons technology you use, which I was quite fascinated by. But even more interesting is your Navy's doctrine, in my opinion."|804|0
units.english: "Modest, aren't we, amusement." she says. "Captain Darius told me much about the weapons technology you use, which I was quite fascinated by. But even more interesting is your Navy's doctrine, in my opinion."
units.italian: "Modesti, noi, divertimento," dice. "Il capitano Darius mi ha parlato molto della tecnologia delle armi che usate, e ne sono rimasta molto affascinata. Ma ancora più interessante, secondo me, è la dottrina della vostra Marina."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"What's so interesting about that?"|806|0
units.english: "What's so interesting about that?"
units.italian: "Che cosa ha di così interessante?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"What do you think of human weapons?"|808|0
units.english: "What do you think of human weapons?"
units.italian: "Che cosa pensi delle armi umane?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Amusement. Everyone always cares more about how big the guns are, rather than how they're used. Your particle cannons, for example, seem much like the light ion accelerators that are common on orbital fortifications, only in the form of linear accelerators instead of the synchrotrons we use. And your beam weapons are particularly puzzling, with their abrupt range limit, yet constant beam intensity along that range. And well, as for those 'blaster cannons,' I have no idea how those are even supposed to work. Firing a projectile with the same properties as a shield, perhaps."|812|0
units.english: "Amusement. Everyone always cares more about how big the guns are, rather than how they're used. Your particle cannons, for example, seem much like the light ion accelerators that are common on orbital fortifications, only in the form of linear accelerators instead of the synchrotrons we use. And your beam weapons are particularly puzzling, with their abrupt range limit, yet constant beam intensity along that range. And well, as for those 'blaster cannons,' I have no idea how those are even supposed to work. Firing a projectile with the same properties as a shield, perhaps."
units.italian: "Divertimento. A tutti interessa sempre di più quanto siano grossi i cannoni, piuttosto che come vengono usati. I vostri cannoni a particelle, per esempio, sembrano molto simili agli acceleratori di ioni leggeri comuni sulle fortificazioni orbitali, solo in forma di acceleratori lineari invece dei sincrotroni che usiamo noi. E le vostre armi a fascio sono particolarmente enigmatiche, con il loro limite di gittata brusco eppure l'intensità del fascio costante lungo quella gittata. E beh, quanto a quei 'cannoni blaster', non ho idea di come dovrebbero funzionare. Spara un proiettile con le stesse proprietà di uno scudo, forse."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"What do you mean, 'how they're used?' Isn't that obvious?"|814|0
units.english: "What do you mean, 'how they're used?' Isn't that obvious?"
units.italian: "Che vuoi dire con 'come vengono usate'? Non è ovvio?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	Claret looks incredulous, standing up animately. "Disbelief. Doctrine is everything. Both in how we design our weapons and how we actually employ them. Everything is built for a specific purpose, from the largest nuclear missile to the humblest coilgun. You must know your objective, your reason for being, and then you must look at the enemy and see the tools they have to stop you, and then develop your own to counter them. Everything your fleet carries must have a specific purpose, a way to fit into the engagement you have planned, or it is simply dead weight."|817|0
units.english: Claret looks incredulous, standing up animately. "Disbelief. Doctrine is everything. Both in how we design our weapons and how we actually employ them. Everything is built for a specific purpose, from the largest nuclear missile to the humblest coilgun. You must know your objective, your reason for being, and then you must look at the enemy and see the tools they have to stop you, and then develop your own to counter them. Everything your fleet carries must have a specific purpose, a way to fit into the engagement you have planned, or it is simply dead weight."
units.italian: Claret sembra incredula e si alza in piedi animatamente. "Incredulità. La dottrina è tutto. Sia nel modo in cui progettiamo le armi sia nel modo in cui le impieghiamo davvero. Tutto è costruito per uno scopo specifico, dal più grande missile nucleare alla più umile coilgun. Devi conoscere il tuo obiettivo, la tua ragione di esistere, e poi devi guardare il nemico e vedere gli strumenti che ha per fermarti, e sviluppare i tuoi per contrastarli. Tutto ciò che la tua flotta porta deve avere uno scopo specifico, un modo per inserirsi nello scontro che hai pianificato, o è semplicemente zavorra."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"What if you don't know what the enemy has?"|819|0
units.english: "What if you don't know what the enemy has?"
units.italian: "E se non sai che cosa ha il nemico?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Impatience. That's why you gather information, assess their capabilities, and train against a wide variety of threats, even ones well beyond what you think an enemy might really have. All of that informs the way you choose to fight."|821|0
units.english: "Impatience. That's why you gather information, assess their capabilities, and train against a wide variety of threats, even ones well beyond what you think an enemy might really have. All of that informs the way you choose to fight."
units.italian: "Impazienza. È per questo che raccogli informazioni, valuti le loro capacità e ti addestri contro una grande varietà di minacce, anche molto oltre ciò che pensi che un nemico potrebbe davvero avere. Tutto questo informa il modo in cui scegli di combattere."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"How did the Avgi fight, then?"|823|0
units.english: "How did the Avgi fight, then?"
units.italian: "E come combattevano gli Avgi, allora?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"So what went wrong against the Aberrant, then? Were they just too powerful?"|824|0
units.english: "So what went wrong against the Aberrant, then? Were they just too powerful?"
units.italian: "Allora che cosa è andato storto contro l'Aberrante? Erano semplicemente troppo potenti?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	She looks a little happier at your question. "Explanation. Quickly and decisively. High intensity battles, to knock out the enemy as quickly as possible while expending as few resources as possible. You spend days, maybe even weeks, just watching to try and pin down your enemy, and then you launch everything you have. Missiles loosed from extreme range, and then long ranged beams to defend yourself as you close with the enemy fleet. Each ship would have a dedicated role, designed to support each other and the overall fleet with specific capabilities while countering those same capabilities held by the enemy."|827|0
units.english: She looks a little happier at your question. "Explanation. Quickly and decisively. High intensity battles, to knock out the enemy as quickly as possible while expending as few resources as possible. You spend days, maybe even weeks, just watching to try and pin down your enemy, and then you launch everything you have. Missiles loosed from extreme range, and then long ranged beams to defend yourself as you close with the enemy fleet. Each ship would have a dedicated role, designed to support each other and the overall fleet with specific capabilities while countering those same capabilities held by the enemy."
units.italian: Sembra un po' più contenta della tua domanda. "Spiegazione. In fretta e con decisione. Battaglie ad alta intensità, per annientare il nemico il più rapidamente possibile spendendo il meno possibile. Passi giorni, forse persino settimane, solo a osservare per cercare di inchiodare il nemico, e poi lanci tutto ciò che hai. Missili scagliati da distanza estrema, e poi fasci a lunga gittata per difenderti mentre ti avvicini alla flotta nemica. Ogni nave aveva un ruolo dedicato, progettata per sostenere le altre e la flotta nel suo insieme con capacità specifiche, contrastando al tempo stesso le stesse capacità in mano al nemico."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	Claret seems to deflate. "Embarrassment. Yes. Well. That wasn't the core of the problem we had against the Aberrant, I think. The admirals will tell you it was because we weren't united enough, that there was too much disagreement between the fleets sent to stop them, or that the Aberrant simply had stronger ships, but the truth is that our fleets were designed to fight other Avgi, not an unknown race of aliens that simply didn't fit into our doctrine. We built them to fight ourselves so well they weren't equipped to fight someone who didn't play by our rules."|830|0
units.english: Claret seems to deflate. "Embarrassment. Yes. Well. That wasn't the core of the problem we had against the Aberrant, I think. The admirals will tell you it was because we weren't united enough, that there was too much disagreement between the fleets sent to stop them, or that the Aberrant simply had stronger ships, but the truth is that our fleets were designed to fight other Avgi, not an unknown race of aliens that simply didn't fit into our doctrine. We built them to fight ourselves so well they weren't equipped to fight someone who didn't play by our rules."
units.italian: Claret sembra sgonfiarsi. "Imbarazzo. Sì. Beh. Non era quello il cuore del problema che avevamo contro l'Aberrante, credo. Gli ammiragli ti diranno che è perché non eravamo abbastanza uniti, che c'erano troppi disaccordi tra le flotte inviate a fermarli, o che l'Aberrante aveva semplicemente navi più forti, ma la verità è che le nostre flotte erano progettate per combattere altri Avgi, non una razza aliena sconosciuta che semplicemente non rientrava nella nostra dottrina. Le abbiamo costruite per combattere noi stessi così bene che non erano attrezzate per combattere qualcuno che non giocava con le nostre regole."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"What happened in those first battles?"|832|0
units.english: "What happened in those first battles?"
units.italian: "Che cosa è successo in quei primi scontri?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"So how has your doctrine changed since then?"|833|0
units.english: "So how has your doctrine changed since then?"
units.italian: "E come è cambiata la vostra dottrina da allora?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"We used to have years to look into the capabilities of our likely opponents, and try and figure out what they could do and how well they could do it. We had missiles designed to track enemy torches, and ships filled with enough of them to kill half a dozen peers before needing resupply. And that worked, because it wasn't like a giant fleet of nigh-invincible enemies was going to appear out of nowhere, right?"|836|0
units.english: "We used to have years to look into the capabilities of our likely opponents, and try and figure out what they could do and how well they could do it. We had missiles designed to track enemy torches, and ships filled with enough of them to kill half a dozen peers before needing resupply. And that worked, because it wasn't like a giant fleet of nigh-invincible enemies was going to appear out of nowhere, right?"
units.italian: "Una volta avevamo anni per studiare le capacità dei nostri probabili avversari e cercare di capire che cosa sapessero fare e quanto bene. Avevamo missili progettati per seguire le scie nemiche, e navi piene abbastanza da uccidere una mezza dozzina di pari prima di dover essere rifornite. E funzionava, perché non era mica come se una flotta gigantesca di nemici quasi invincibili potesse apparire dal nulla, giusto?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	She clicks her fingers. "Despair. All of that failed against the Aberrant. We weren't well equipped to track them at range, with how dim their engines are compared to us, and letting them get close was a death sentence for ships that mostly carried long range nuclear missiles. The first encounters with them were one-sided slaughters, until engineers slapped bigger radar arrays on our ships to try and spot the Aberrant before they could tear through us."|837|0
units.english: She clicks her fingers. "Despair. All of that failed against the Aberrant. We weren't well equipped to track them at range, with how dim their engines are compared to us, and letting them get close was a death sentence for ships that mostly carried long range nuclear missiles. The first encounters with them were one-sided slaughters, until engineers slapped bigger radar arrays on our ships to try and spot the Aberrant before they could tear through us."
units.italian: Fa schioccare le dita. "Disperazione. Tutto questo fallì contro l'Aberrante. Non eravamo ben attrezzati per seguirli a distanza, con quanto sono deboli i loro motori rispetto ai nostri, e lasciarli avvicinare era una condanna a morte per navi che portavano soprattutto missili nucleari a lungo raggio. I primi incontri con loro furono massacri a senso unico, finché gli ingegneri non ci hanno montato radar più grandi sulle navi per cercare di individuare l'Aberrante prima che potesse squarciarci."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Did that work?"|839|0
units.english: "Did that work?"
units.italian: "Ha funzionato?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"That stopped the bloodletting, for a while. Apprehension. Until the front lines began to run low on missiles. When it takes a ship's entire magazine to kill an Aberrant before it has to retreat and resupply, it simply isn't sustainable. And the particle beams wielded by some of our ships, the ones that could fight at long range, were simply absorbed by the Aberrant's shields, something we're still trying to overcome. But for a while it seemed like nothing was working."|841|0
units.english: "That stopped the bloodletting, for a while. Apprehension. Until the front lines began to run low on missiles. When it takes a ship's entire magazine to kill an Aberrant before it has to retreat and resupply, it simply isn't sustainable. And the particle beams wielded by some of our ships, the ones that could fight at long range, were simply absorbed by the Aberrant's shields, something we're still trying to overcome. But for a while it seemed like nothing was working."
units.italian: "Quello ha fermato il salasso, per un po'. Apprensione. Finché le linee del fronte non hanno cominciato a restare a corto di missili. Quando serve l'intero caricatore di una nave per uccidere un Aberrante prima che debba ritirarsi e rifornirsi, semplicemente non è sostenibile. E i fasci di particelle impugnati da alcune delle nostre navi, quelli che potevano combattere a lungo raggio, venivano semplicemente assorbiti dagli scudi dell'Aberrante, cosa che stiamo ancora cercando di superare. Per un po' sembrò che nulla funzionasse."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Praise. We had to completely throw out everything we thought we knew and start over. We ended up bringing back coilguns and kinetic kill vehicles - ridiculously short range weapons compared to a serious beam or missile. But it's what we could field at short notice, and build in the numbers needed to at least hold the Aberrant at bay.
