What we fly these days would probably be slaughtered by a pre-Incursion fleet, but the Aberrant fight at a much shorter range anyway, and our modern fleets have much better endurance when it comes to ammunition."|844|0
units.english: "Praise. We had to completely throw out everything we thought we knew and start over. We ended up bringing back coilguns and kinetic kill vehicles - ridiculously short range weapons compared to a serious beam or missile. But it's what we could field at short notice, and build in the numbers needed to at least hold the Aberrant at bay. What we fly these days would probably be slaughtered by a pre-Incursion fleet, but the Aberrant fight at a much shorter range anyway, and our modern fleets have much better endurance when it comes to ammunition."
units.italian: "Lode. Abbiamo dovuto buttare via del tutto tutto ciò che credevamo di sapere e ricominciare. Alla fine abbiamo riportato in servizio coilgun e veicoli a impatto cinetico, armi di gittata ridicolmente corta rispetto a un fascio o a un missile serio. Ma è quello che potevamo schierare in breve tempo, e costruire nei numeri necessari almeno a tenere l'Aberrante a bada. Quello con cui voliamo oggi sarebbe probabilmente massacrato da una flotta pre-Incursione, ma l'Aberrante combatte comunque a distanze molto più corte, e le nostre flotte moderne hanno un'autonomia molto migliore quanto a munizioni."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	Claret thrums with laughter. "If you had told a planner that we'd be fighting with coilguns and kinetic kill vehicles, before the Incursion you'd have been laughed out of the room. But we're lucky that the Aberrant's weapons are short ranged, such that we can actually hit them at the range of a dumb projectile from a coilgun without being instantly swatted out of the sky."|845|0
units.english: Claret thrums with laughter. "If you had told a planner that we'd be fighting with coilguns and kinetic kill vehicles, before the Incursion you'd have been laughed out of the room. But we're lucky that the Aberrant's weapons are short ranged, such that we can actually hit them at the range of a dumb projectile from a coilgun without being instantly swatted out of the sky."
units.italian: Claret vibra di risate. "Se prima dell'Incursione avessi detto a un pianificatore che avremmo combattuto con coilgun e veicoli a impatto cinetico, saresti stato cacciato dalla stanza a risate. Ma siamo fortunati che le armi dell'Aberrante siano a corto raggio, così che possiamo davvero colpirli alla distanza di un proiettile stupido sparato da una coilgun senza essere immediatamente abbattuti."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Don't the Aberrant still have superior technology?"|848|0
units.english: "Don't the Aberrant still have superior technology?"
units.italian: "L'Aberrante non ha ancora una tecnologia superiore?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"And now you're able to hold your own against them?"|850|0
units.english: "And now you're able to hold your own against them?"
units.italian: "E ora riuscite a tenergli testa?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Discomfort. Maybe at first, when we could count on having a numerical advantage, but the Aberrant continue to reproduce at a faster rate than we can build ships. And these new weapons, well, they were considered obsolete for a reason. We need something that can dish out more damage, and at a longer range, without being as expensive and resource-intensive as a missile."|852|0
units.english: "Discomfort. Maybe at first, when we could count on having a numerical advantage, but the Aberrant continue to reproduce at a faster rate than we can build ships. And these new weapons, well, they were considered obsolete for a reason. We need something that can dish out more damage, and at a longer range, without being as expensive and resource-intensive as a missile."
units.italian: "Disagio. Forse all'inizio, quando potevamo contare su un vantaggio numerico, ma l'Aberrante continua a riprodursi a un ritmo più veloce di quanto noi si costruisca navi. E queste nuove armi, beh, erano considerate obsolete per una ragione. Ci serve qualcosa che sappia infliggere più danni, e a gittata più lunga, senza essere costoso e affamato di risorse come un missile."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Oh, yes, appreciation. But they don't use it to its full extent, probably because they aren't intelligent beings in their own right. They just make more of each other, without any changes other than occasional mistakes. And their weapons don't seem like they were meant to be weapons, if that makes sense. More of a cutting beam than a true weaponized laser."|856|0
units.english: "Oh, yes, appreciation. But they don't use it to its full extent, probably because they aren't intelligent beings in their own right. They just make more of each other, without any changes other than occasional mistakes. And their weapons don't seem like they were meant to be weapons, if that makes sense. More of a cutting beam than a true weaponized laser."
units.italian: "Oh, sì, riconoscenza. Ma non la usano fino in fondo, probabilmente perché non sono esseri intelligenti di per sé. Si limitano a produrre altri di sé, senza cambiamenti se non occasionali errori. E le loro armi non sembrano pensate per essere armi, se ha senso. Più un fascio da taglio che un vero laser weaponizzato."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"That's why things really were desperate, until you humans came around. That changed everything, knowing there was a non-hostile, if not outright friendly, alien power nearby. Even though it sounds like your government isn't able to help directly, given the lack of connecting starways, technological support from a more advanced species could be enough for us to win. Shields, shared by your people, were already a game changer by themselves."|859|0
units.english: "That's why things really were desperate, until you humans came around. That changed everything, knowing there was a non-hostile, if not outright friendly, alien power nearby. Even though it sounds like your government isn't able to help directly, given the lack of connecting starways, technological support from a more advanced species could be enough for us to win. Shields, shared by your people, were already a game changer by themselves."
units.italian: "Ecco perché le cose erano davvero disperate, finché non siete arrivati voi umani. Questo ha cambiato tutto, sapere che c'era una potenza aliena non ostile, se non addirittura amichevole, qui vicino. Anche se sembra che il vostro governo non possa aiutare direttamente, data la mancanza di vie stellari che ci colleghino, il sostegno tecnologico di una specie più avanzata potrebbe bastarci per vincere. Gli scudi, condivisi dai tuoi, erano già di per sé un punto di svolta."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"I'm not sure humanity would be able to help all that much, with our technology."|862|0
units.english: "I'm not sure humanity would be able to help all that much, with our technology."
units.italian: "Non sono sicuro che l'umanità potrebbe aiutare più di tanto, con la nostra tecnologia."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Wait, you got shields from us?"|864|0
units.english: "Wait, you got shields from us?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, avete preso gli scudi da noi?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"From the humans that were stranded here, yes, gratitude. They let us dismantle their ship's shield generator and explained the rough concept to us, and we've been able to produce our own imitation, though I hear it isn't nearly as good."|865|0
units.english: "From the humans that were stranded here, yes, gratitude. They let us dismantle their ship's shield generator and explained the rough concept to us, and we've been able to produce our own imitation, though I hear it isn't nearly as good."
units.italian: "Dagli umani rimasti bloccati qui, sì, riconoscenza. Ci hanno lasciato smontare il generatore di scudi della loro nave e ci hanno spiegato il concetto di massima, e siamo riusciti a produrre una nostra imitazione, anche se sento dire che non è neanche lontanamente buona uguale."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"Dismissal. I've seen the <ship>, and the ship your friends arrived on. That's the kind of firepower we need to take on the Aberrant and win."|868|0
units.english: "Dismissal. I've seen the <ship>, and the ship your friends arrived on. That's the kind of firepower we need to take on the Aberrant and win."
units.italian: "Sdegno. Ho visto la <ship>, e la nave su cui sono arrivati i tuoi amici. È quel genere di potenza di fuoco che ci serve per affrontare l'Aberrante e vincere."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"If you say so."|870|0
units.english: "If you say so."
units.italian: "Se lo dici tu."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"I hope you're right."|871|0
units.english: "I hope you're right."
units.italian: "Spero che tu abbia ragione."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	With that, you turn to lighter topics, as Claret finishes her drink. You learn about the new traditions the Twilight Guard is trying to promote to ensure unity and cohesion within its ranks, trying to bind together former members of dozens of independent militaries into a united whole. This apparently involves a lot of travel to promote inter-unit bonding, as well as frequent cycling between the front lines and the Outer Limits.|874|0
units.english: With that, you turn to lighter topics, as Claret finishes her drink. You learn about the new traditions the Twilight Guard is trying to promote to ensure unity and cohesion within its ranks, trying to bind together former members of dozens of independent militaries into a united whole. This apparently involves a lot of travel to promote inter-unit bonding, as well as frequent cycling between the front lines and the Outer Limits.
units.italian: Detto questo, passate ad argomenti più leggeri, mentre Claret finisce la sua bevanda. Vieni a sapere delle nuove tradizioni che la Twilight Guard sta cercando di promuovere per assicurare unità e coesione nei suoi ranghi, provando a legare insieme ex membri di dozzine di eserciti indipendenti in un tutto unico. Questo comporta apparentemente molti viaggi per favorire i legami tra reparti, oltre a frequenti rotazioni tra le linee del fronte e gli Outer Limits.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	Eventually, Claret is ready to leave. "Anyway, I'll see you around. And, a word of advice. If you're ever on a Twilight Guard station, look out for officers or Guardsmen who are looking for a ride. We often have people trying to make an impromptu trip, and our logistics have been so overstretched lately they're willing to contract with outside captains, if they're trustworthy."|875|0
units.english: Eventually, Claret is ready to leave. "Anyway, I'll see you around. And, a word of advice. If you're ever on a Twilight Guard station, look out for officers or Guardsmen who are looking for a ride. We often have people trying to make an impromptu trip, and our logistics have been so overstretched lately they're willing to contract with outside captains, if they're trustworthy."
units.italian: Alla fine Claret è pronta ad andarsene. "Comunque, ci vediamo in giro. E, un consiglio. Se mai ti trovi su una stazione della Twilight Guard, tieni d'occhio gli ufficiali o le Guardie che cercano un passaggio. Spesso abbiamo gente che cerca di fare un viaggio improvvisato, e la nostra logistica è stata così oberata ultimamente che sono disposti a contrattare con capitani esterni, se sono affidabili."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Twilight Tavern Guard|	"I'll keep that in mind," you say.|876|0
units.english: "I'll keep that in mind," you say.
units.italian: "Me lo ricorderò," dici.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|name|882|0
units.english: Atomic Testing
units.italian: Atomic Testing

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|description|883|0
units.english: Take Aliza and her colleagues to the surface of Dokimi.
units.italian: Porta Aliza e i suoi colleghi sulla superficie di Dokimi.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|blocked|886|0
units.english: You need <capacity> to transport Aliza and her colleagues to Dokimi.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per trasportare Aliza e i suoi colleghi su Dokimi.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|log|891|0
units.english: Alizarin, or Aliza, is a scientist working on Ergastirio Station. She specializes in nuclear weapons design and testing, specifically in shockwave dynamics and accelerator testing. With a bit of a passion for nuclear weapons, she is eager to share what she knows.
units.italian: Alizarin, o Aliza, è una scienziata che lavora alla Stazione Ergastirio. È specializzata nella progettazione e nel collaudo di armi nucleari, in particolare nella dinamica delle onde d'urto e nei test sugli acceleratori. Con una certa passione per le armi nucleari, è impaziente di condividere ciò che sa.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|Ergastirio Station is quiet as you disembark from the <ship>. Everyone you see seems purposeful and deliberate, moving as if they all know exactly where they need to be. Wandering about as you are, you can't help but feel that you stand out, a feeling that proves warranted when a female Avgi stops you, a vibrant red tinged with purple.|895|0
units.english: Ergastirio Station is quiet as you disembark from the <ship>. Everyone you see seems purposeful and deliberate, moving as if they all know exactly where they need to be. Wandering about as you are, you can't help but feel that you stand out, a feeling that proves warranted when a female Avgi stops you, a vibrant red tinged with purple.
units.italian: La Stazione Ergastirio è silenziosa mentre sbarchi dalla <ship>. Tutti quelli che vedi sembrano determinati e deliberati, si muovono come se sapessero esattamente dove devono andare. Vagando come fai tu, non puoi evitare di sentirti fuori posto, sensazione che si rivela fondata quando un'Avgi femmina ti ferma, di un rosso vibrante venato di viola.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Curiosity, hello. Who are you?"|896|0
units.english: "Curiosity, hello. Who are you?"
units.italian: "Curiosità, salve. Tu chi sei?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Sorry, I was just looking around."|898|0
units.english: "Sorry, I was just looking around."
units.italian: "Scusa, stavo solo guardandomi intorno."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Sorry, am I not supposed to be here?"|899|0
units.english: "Sorry, am I not supposed to be here?"
units.italian: "Scusa, non dovrei essere qui?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Oh. Amusement," she thrums in laughter for a moment, "it isn't that, I've just never met an alien before."|901|0
units.english: "Oh. Amusement," she thrums in laughter for a moment, "it isn't that, I've just never met an alien before."
units.italian: "Oh. Divertimento," vibra di risate per un momento, "non è per quello, è che non ho mai incontrato un alieno prima."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|"Oh. That makes sense," you say, feeling a bit stupid.|902|0
units.english: "Oh. That makes sense," you say, feeling a bit stupid.
units.italian: "Oh. Ha senso," dici, sentendoti un po' sciocco.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"I'm Alizarin, but you can call me Aliza. I'm a senior research fellow here at Ergastirio," she says with a touch of pride.|903|0
units.english: "I'm Alizarin, but you can call me Aliza. I'm a senior research fellow here at Ergastirio," she says with a touch of pride.
units.italian: "Sono Alizarin, ma puoi chiamarmi Aliza. Sono una ricercatrice senior qui a Ergastirio," dice con un pizzico di orgoglio.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"What kind of stuff do you do here?"|905|0
units.english: "What kind of stuff do you do here?"
units.italian: "Che genere di cose fate qui?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"What do you research?"|906|0
units.english: "What do you research?"
units.italian: "Su che cosa fai ricerca?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Well, I'm a shockwave dynamics specialist, though I dabble in accelerator testing occasionally. My work with both of those is in nuclear weapons design, mostly in implosion and ablation modeling. We do all sorts of stuff here though, but it's all weapons related. Not much of a choice with the War, you know."|908|0
units.english: "Well, I'm a shockwave dynamics specialist, though I dabble in accelerator testing occasionally. My work with both of those is in nuclear weapons design, mostly in implosion and ablation modeling. We do all sorts of stuff here though, but it's all weapons related. Not much of a choice with the War, you know."
units.italian: "Beh, sono specialista in dinamica delle onde d'urto, anche se ogni tanto mi occupo di test sugli acceleratori. Il mio lavoro su entrambi riguarda la progettazione di armi nucleari, soprattutto la modellistica di implosione e ablazione. Qui però facciamo di tutto, anche se tutto legato alle armi. Non c'è molta scelta con la Guerra, sai."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Nuclear weapons? Fascinating."|910|0
units.english: "Nuclear weapons? Fascinating."
units.italian: "Armi nucleari? Affascinante."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Nuclear weapons? That's... interesting, I guess."|912|0
units.english: "Nuclear weapons? That's... interesting, I guess."
units.italian: "Armi nucleari? È... interessante, suppongo."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Nuclear weapons? I'm not a fan honestly."|913|0
units.english: "Nuclear weapons? I'm not a fan honestly."
units.italian: "Armi nucleari? A dire il vero non sono un fan."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Ah, well. Not everyone can appreciate art. But you'll see the light, heh heh, when the Aberrant come knocking. Nothing else hits 'em the same way, appreciation."|915|0
units.english: "Ah, well. Not everyone can appreciate art. But you'll see the light, heh heh, when the Aberrant come knocking. Nothing else hits 'em the same way, appreciation."
units.italian: "Ah, beh. Non tutti possono apprezzare l'arte. Ma vedrai la luce, eh eh, quando l'Aberrante verrà a bussare. Niente altro li colpisce allo stesso modo, riconoscenza."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Enthusiasm. They are! I wish there was time to explain the fine art of weapons design, but alas, I have an appointment in less than an hour... Consideration. Actually, I've just had an idea," she says, looking thoughtful.|919|0
units.english: "Enthusiasm. They are! I wish there was time to explain the fine art of weapons design, but alas, I have an appointment in less than an hour... Consideration. Actually, I've just had an idea," she says, looking thoughtful.
units.italian: "Entusiasmo. Lo sono! Vorrei che ci fosse il tempo di spiegarti la bella arte del progetto delle armi, ma ahimè ho un appuntamento tra meno di un'ora... Considerazione. Anzi, mi è appena venuta un'idea," dice, con aria pensierosa.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|label|921|0
units.english: wanna see
units.italian: wanna see

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Hey, you've been vetted by the Assembly itself, right? You wanna see an atomics test? We've got one scheduled for today, and I heard you aliens are scared of nukes, so you've probably never seen one before."|922|0
units.english: "Hey, you've been vetted by the Assembly itself, right? You wanna see an atomics test? We've got one scheduled for today, and I heard you aliens are scared of nukes, so you've probably never seen one before."
units.italian: "Ehi, tu sei stato verificato dall'Assemblea stessa, vero? Ti va di vedere un test atomico? Ne abbiamo uno in programma per oggi, e ho sentito che voi alieni avete paura delle atomiche, quindi probabilmente non ne hai mai vista una."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Sure, why not?"|924|0
units.english: "Sure, why not?"
units.italian: "Certo, perché no?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"I'll pass."|926|0
units.english: "I'll pass."
units.italian: "Passo."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Actually, I have. It wasn't pretty."|928|0
units.english: "Actually, I have. It wasn't pretty."
units.italian: "A dire il vero ne ho viste. Non è stato bello."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Surprise. I thought you had some kind of taboo around them, no?"|936|0
units.english: "Surprise. I thought you had some kind of taboo around them, no?"
units.italian: "Sorpresa. Pensavo aveste una sorta di tabù al riguardo, no?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Some people decided to break that taboo."|938|0
units.english: "Some people decided to break that taboo."
units.italian: "Alcuni hanno deciso di infrangere quel tabù."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Things in human space have changed since then."|939|0
units.english: "Things in human space have changed since then."
units.italian: "Le cose nello spazio umano sono cambiate da allora."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Ah, that's good to hear. From what I've heard you humans are rather silly about atomics, as though the average hyperdrive wasn't handling energies of the same order. Anyway, do you want to see an atomics test?"|940|0
units.english: "Ah, that's good to hear. From what I've heard you humans are rather silly about atomics, as though the average hyperdrive wasn't handling energies of the same order. Anyway, do you want to see an atomics test?"
units.italian: "Ah, è bello sentirlo. Da quello che ho sentito, voi umani siete piuttosto sciocchi sulle atomiche, come se l'hyperdrive medio non gestisse energie dello stesso ordine. Comunque, vuoi vedere un test atomico?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Sure, why not?"|942|0
units.english: "Sure, why not?"
units.italian: "Certo, perché no?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"I'll pass. Nothing I haven't seen before."|944|0
units.english: "I'll pass. Nothing I haven't seen before."
units.italian: "Passo. Niente che non abbia già visto."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Disappointment. You're missing out, but oh well. Anyway, I gotta go, catch ya later!" Aliza scampers off towards a few Avgi waving at her by a door.|948|0
units.english: "Disappointment. You're missing out, but oh well. Anyway, I gotta go, catch ya later!" Aliza scampers off towards a few Avgi waving at her by a door.
units.italian: "Delusione. Ti perdi qualcosa, ma pazienza. Comunque devo andare, ci vediamo dopo!" Aliza sgambetta via verso qualche Avgi che le fa cenni da una porta.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Joy. Excellent! We do our testing on the dwarf planet below, at the Dokimi Range. A good place for testing the more exciting projects, far from anything valuable of course."|952|0
units.english: "Joy. Excellent! We do our testing on the dwarf planet below, at the Dokimi Range. A good place for testing the more exciting projects, far from anything valuable of course."
units.italian: "Gioia. Eccellente! Facciamo i nostri test sul pianeta nano qui sotto, al Poligono di Dokimi. Un buon posto per collaudare i progetti più eccitanti, lontano da qualsiasi cosa di valore, naturalmente."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	You're interrupted by another Avgi, who lands right in front of you. With his wings still fanned out from his faded blue body, he ignores you to point at Aliza accusingly.|953|0
units.english: You're interrupted by another Avgi, who lands right in front of you. With his wings still fanned out from his faded blue body, he ignores you to point at Aliza accusingly.
units.italian: Vieni interrotto da un altro Avgi, che atterra proprio davanti a te. Con le ali ancora spiegate dal corpo di un blu sbiadito, ti ignora per puntare un dito accusatorio verso Aliza.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Impatience. Ah, Alizarin, just who I was looking for." He waves his arms frantically as he dances around. "I was hoping you would have sent the new beam-target interaction results along my way by now, but your office claimed you were busy with a more important project, which I simply cannot believe is the case."|954|0
units.english: "Impatience. Ah, Alizarin, just who I was looking for." He waves his arms frantically as he dances around. "I was hoping you would have sent the new beam-target interaction results along my way by now, but your office claimed you were busy with a more important project, which I simply cannot believe is the case."
units.italian: "Impazienza. Ah, Alizarin, proprio chi cercavo." Agita le braccia freneticamente mentre le balla intorno. "Speravo che mi avresti già mandato i nuovi risultati sull'interazione fascio-bersaglio, ma il tuo ufficio sostiene che eri occupata con un progetto più importante, cosa che semplicemente non posso credere sia vera."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	Aliza folds her arms. "Annoyance. I don't know what to tell you, Trypan, we're working our way through the backlog as fast as we can. I can't get you your accelerator time any faster, you know that's just not how it works."|955|0
units.english: Aliza folds her arms. "Annoyance. I don't know what to tell you, Trypan, we're working our way through the backlog as fast as we can. I can't get you your accelerator time any faster, you know that's just not how it works."
units.italian: Aliza incrocia le braccia. "Fastidio. Non so che dirti, Trypan, stiamo smaltendo l'arretrato il più in fretta possibile. Non posso procurarti il tempo di acceleratore più velocemente, sai che non funziona così."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Disgust. You do know what's at stake, do you not? We need that data, it is utterly critical to our work! This new armor will be impenetrable, a shield that could win the War!" Trypan tries to look stern and disappointed, an effect that is not helped by the fact that he keeps prancing around you.|956|0
units.english: "Disgust. You do know what's at stake, do you not? We need that data, it is utterly critical to our work! This new armor will be impenetrable, a shield that could win the War!" Trypan tries to look stern and disappointed, an effect that is not helped by the fact that he keeps prancing around you.
units.italian: "Disgusto. Sai bene che cosa è in gioco, no? Ci servono quei dati, sono assolutamente critici per il nostro lavoro! Questa nuova armatura sarà impenetrabile, uno scudo che potrebbe vincere la Guerra!" Trypan cerca di apparire severo e deluso, effetto che non è aiutato dal fatto che continua a saltellarti intorno.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Who was that?"|958|0
units.english: "Who was that?"
units.italian: "Chi era quello?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"What did he mean by 'impenetrable armor?'"|959|0
units.english: "What did he mean by 'impenetrable armor?'"
units.italian: "Che cosa intendeva con 'armatura impenetrabile'?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Annoyance. That was Trypan. My point of contact with a group of wealthy individuals with far too much influence and not enough sense. For years they've been convinced we just need 'one more prototype, just one more experiment' to produce a breakthrough to win the War. She sighs. "No one really takes them seriously anymore, not after all the failed projects they've sponsored, but they do shell out the equipment we need for free, so we have to at least act like we're listening to their 'new ideas.' That they have a few seats in the Consonance between them doesn't hurt either, when we need more resources or funding."|962|0
units.english: "Annoyance. That was Trypan. My point of contact with a group of wealthy individuals with far too much influence and not enough sense. For years they've been convinced we just need 'one more prototype, just one more experiment' to produce a breakthrough to win the War. She sighs. "No one really takes them seriously anymore, not after all the failed projects they've sponsored, but they do shell out the equipment we need for free, so we have to at least act like we're listening to their 'new ideas.' That they have a few seats in the Consonance between them doesn't hurt either, when we need more resources or funding."
units.italian: "Fastidio. Quello era Trypan. Il mio punto di contatto con un gruppo di individui facoltosi con troppa influenza e poco buon senso. Da anni sono convinti che ci serva solo 'un altro prototipo, un altro esperimento' per produrre un passo avanti decisivo e vincere la Guerra. Sospira. "Nessuno li prende più davvero sul serio, non dopo tutti i progetti falliti che hanno finanziato, ma sganciano comunque l'attrezzatura che ci serve gratis, quindi dobbiamo almeno fare finta di ascoltare le loro 'nuove idee'. Che tra loro abbiano qualche seggio nella Consonanza non guasta nemmeno, quando ci servono più risorse o finanziamenti."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Trypan and his technocrat friends are convinced they're on the verge of a breakthrough to 'win the War,' as they love to claim. For a while they were obsessed with absurd superweapons - had us actually try again to develop a hyperspace weapon, despite everyone trying that for decades. There's basically no theory behind the idea anyway, trust me," she assures you. "Now they're convinced we can cook up a supermaterial of some kind that will be invulnerable to the Aberrant beams, when we still don't even really know how they work."|965|0
units.english: "Trypan and his technocrat friends are convinced they're on the verge of a breakthrough to 'win the War,' as they love to claim. For a while they were obsessed with absurd superweapons - had us actually try again to develop a hyperspace weapon, despite everyone trying that for decades. There's basically no theory behind the idea anyway, trust me," she assures you. "Now they're convinced we can cook up a supermaterial of some kind that will be invulnerable to the Aberrant beams, when we still don't even really know how they work."
units.italian: "Trypan e i suoi amici tecnocrati sono convinti di essere sul punto di un passo decisivo per 'vincere la Guerra', come amano dire. Per un po' sono stati ossessionati da assurde superarmi: ci hanno fatto provare di nuovo a sviluppare un'arma iperspaziale, nonostante tutti ci provino da decenni. Non c'è praticamente nessuna teoria dietro l'idea, comunque, credimi," ti assicura. "Ora sono convinti che possiamo inventare una sorta di supermateriale invulnerabile ai fasci dell'Aberrante, quando ancora non sappiamo bene nemmeno come funzionino."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	She shakes her head animatedly, looking rather put off. "He and the group backing him have been having us run their 'prototype' samples through our linear accelerator - this big 'ol electron beam in the Third Wing of the station. We use it for all sorts of research, and we do conduct material testing with it, but it's gotten ridiculous lately. They keep acting surprised when we burn through their plates of whatever alloy they've cooked up in a fraction of a second." She gives you an amused look. "At least that makes each beam run short, but cleaning out the accelerator is more annoying than you'd think."|966|0
units.english: She shakes her head animatedly, looking rather put off. "He and the group backing him have been having us run their 'prototype' samples through our linear accelerator - this big 'ol electron beam in the Third Wing of the station. We use it for all sorts of research, and we do conduct material testing with it, but it's gotten ridiculous lately. They keep acting surprised when we burn through their plates of whatever alloy they've cooked up in a fraction of a second." She gives you an amused look. "At least that makes each beam run short, but cleaning out the accelerator is more annoying than you'd think."
units.italian: Scuote la testa animatamente, con aria piuttosto seccata. "Lui e il gruppo che lo sostiene ci fanno passare i campioni dei loro 'prototipi' nel nostro acceleratore lineare: quel gran fascio di elettroni nella Terza Ala della stazione. Lo usiamo per ogni sorta di ricerca, e facciamo anche collaudi di materiali, ma ultimamente è diventata una follia. Continuano a restare sorpresi quando bruciamo le loro piastre di chissà quale lega abbiano inventato in una frazione di secondo." Ti lancia uno sguardo divertito. "Almeno così ogni passata del fascio è breve, ma pulire l'acceleratore è più fastidioso di quanto pensi."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	She looks past you, towards a door. "Ah, my colleagues. We were going to catch an Akoustiki down to the surface, but you have a ship, right? Want to be our ride?"|967|0
units.english: She looks past you, towards a door. "Ah, my colleagues. We were going to catch an Akoustiki down to the surface, but you have a ship, right? Want to be our ride?"
units.italian: Guarda oltre te, verso una porta. "Ah, i miei colleghi. Stavamo per prendere un Akoustiki per scendere in superficie, ma tu hai una nave, vero? Vuoi essere il nostro passaggio?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"Of course."|969|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Ma certo."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 1|	"I don't have time, sorry."|971|0
units.english: "I don't have time, sorry."
units.italian: "Non ho tempo, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|name|977|0
units.english: Atomic Testing
units.italian: Atomic Testing

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|description|978|0
units.english: Take Aliza back to <destination>.
units.italian: Riporta Aliza su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|The descent to Dokimi is uneventful, but you get a good look at the planetoid's icy surface, stained red with organic tholins. The ice is smooth and pristine under most of your flight path, but eventually something new comes into view: austere buildings, crude roads, and overshadowing all else, the flat expanse of a field pockmarked with craters.|987|0
units.english: The descent to Dokimi is uneventful, but you get a good look at the planetoid's icy surface, stained red with organic tholins. The ice is smooth and pristine under most of your flight path, but eventually something new comes into view: austere buildings, crude roads, and overshadowing all else, the flat expanse of a field pockmarked with craters.
units.italian: La discesa verso Dokimi è tranquilla, ma hai modo di osservare bene la superficie ghiacciata del planetoide, macchiata di rosso dalle toline organiche. Il ghiaccio è liscio e intatto per la maggior parte della rotta, ma alla fine qualcosa di nuovo entra in vista: edifici austeri, strade grezze e, sovrastante su tutto, la distesa piatta di un campo butterata di crateri.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"A little dreary, isn't it, amusement?" comments Aliza.|991|0
units.english: "A little dreary, isn't it, amusement?" comments Aliza.
units.italian: "Un po' desolante, non è vero, divertimento?" commenta Aliza.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Yeah. Why do testing out here instead of in empty space?"|993|0
units.english: "Yeah. Why do testing out here instead of in empty space?"
units.italian: "Sì. Perché fate i test quaggiù invece che nello spazio vuoto?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Do you just test nukes here?"|994|0
units.english: "Do you just test nukes here?"
units.italian: "Fate solo test nucleari qui?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"It's nice to have a big mass to brace experiments against and bury sensors in, explanation. Plus we get to see the effects of weapons on bulk mass, like all this ice and the occasional rock outcropping. It makes quite the blast plume," she adds happily.|997|0
units.english: "It's nice to have a big mass to brace experiments against and bury sensors in, explanation. Plus we get to see the effects of weapons on bulk mass, like all this ice and the occasional rock outcropping. It makes quite the blast plume," she adds happily.
units.italian: "È comodo avere una grande massa contro cui puntellare gli esperimenti e in cui seppellire i sensori, spiegazione. In più possiamo vedere gli effetti delle armi su una massa consistente, come tutto questo ghiaccio e qualche affioramento roccioso. Fa una bella colonna di fuoco," aggiunge felice.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"We used to use some big asteroids for this, but we kept blowing through them, amusement. Relocating our lab after every big test was getting annoying, so we picked this planetoid out and stuck an outpost on it."|998|0
units.english: "We used to use some big asteroids for this, but we kept blowing through them, amusement. Relocating our lab after every big test was getting annoying, so we picked this planetoid out and stuck an outpost on it."
units.italian: "Un tempo usavamo dei grossi asteroidi per questo, ma continuavamo a consumarli, divertimento. Spostare il laboratorio dopo ogni grande test stava diventando fastidioso, così abbiamo scelto questo planetoide e ci abbiamo messo un avamposto."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Why this planet in particular?"|1000|0
units.english: "Why this planet in particular?"
units.italian: "Perché proprio questo pianeta?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Blowing through asteroids? Just how big are these nukes?"|1001|0
units.english: "Blowing through asteroids? Just how big are these nukes?"
units.italian: "Consumavate gli asteroidi? Quanto sono grandi queste atomiche?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Consideration." She looks thoughtful. "Well, the lab managers told us to go somewhere far enough from the Navigeo Yards to be out of the way of anything important, so that they don't have to worry about getting flashed with radiation every week. But really I think it's because they wanted their own little planetoid as a personal fief where no one could tell them what to do, and Dokimi is so utterly unremarkable that no one else wanted it for anything else."|1004|0
units.english: "Consideration." She looks thoughtful. "Well, the lab managers told us to go somewhere far enough from the Navigeo Yards to be out of the way of anything important, so that they don't have to worry about getting flashed with radiation every week. But really I think it's because they wanted their own little planetoid as a personal fief where no one could tell them what to do, and Dokimi is so utterly unremarkable that no one else wanted it for anything else."
units.italian: "Considerazione." Sembra pensierosa. "Beh, i responsabili del laboratorio ci hanno detto di andare in un posto abbastanza lontano dai Navigeo Yards da non dare fastidio a nulla di importante, così che non debbano preoccuparsi di prendersi una radiazione ogni settimana. Ma in realtà credo sia perché volevano il loro piccolo planetoide come feudo personale dove nessuno potesse dire loro cosa fare, e Dokimi è così assolutamente insignificante che nessun altro la voleva per altro."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Heh, we can make them as big as we want to. 'Just add more lithium deuteride,' as they say, amusement. Once you get a proper two-stage device, you can pretty much just add more stages to boost the yield. Two or three hundred megatons is easy, if a bit impractical to fit in the sizes of missile we field. But we sometimes test at that range, to validate other ideas and designs."|1008|0
units.english: "Heh, we can make them as big as we want to. 'Just add more lithium deuteride,' as they say, amusement. Once you get a proper two-stage device, you can pretty much just add more stages to boost the yield. Two or three hundred megatons is easy, if a bit impractical to fit in the sizes of missile we field. But we sometimes test at that range, to validate other ideas and designs."
units.italian: "Eh, possiamo farle grandi quanto vogliamo. 'Basta aggiungere altro deuteruro di litio', come dicono, divertimento. Una volta che hai un vero dispositivo a due stadi, puoi praticamente aggiungere altri stadi per aumentare la resa. Due o trecento megatoni sono facili, anche se un po' poco pratici da far stare nelle dimensioni dei missili che schieriamo. Ma a volte collaudiamo in quella gamma, per validare altre idee e progetti."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Nah, we run all sorts of fun stuff that we can't test on Ergastirio, appreciation. The really big particle beams, for example, and reactor pumped lasers that would be annoying to shield on the station."|1012|0
units.english: "Nah, we run all sorts of fun stuff that we can't test on Ergastirio, appreciation. The really big particle beams, for example, and reactor pumped lasers that would be annoying to shield on the station."
units.italian: "No, facciamo ogni sorta di cose divertenti che non possiamo collaudare su Ergastirio, riconoscenza. I fasci di particelle davvero grandi, per esempio, e i laser pompati dal reattore che sarebbero fastidiosi da schermare sulla stazione."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	She gestures out the window, towards some stony mountains. "You can find a valley out that way with all sorts of tracks carved in the ice. I wrote my name in a patch of stone, actually."|1013|0
units.english: She gestures out the window, towards some stony mountains. "You can find a valley out that way with all sorts of tracks carved in the ice. I wrote my name in a patch of stone, actually."
units.italian: Fa un gesto verso la finestra, verso alcune montagne rocciose. "Da quella parte puoi trovare una valle con ogni sorta di tracce incise nel ghiaccio. Io ho scritto il mio nome su una chiazza di pietra, a dire il vero."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	At Aliza's direction, you set the <ship> down on an icy pad by one of the small buildings. A few Avgi come out to greet you, wearing silver-colored spacesuits with comically large bubble helmets.|1017|0
units.english: At Aliza's direction, you set the <ship> down on an icy pad by one of the small buildings. A few Avgi come out to greet you, wearing silver-colored spacesuits with comically large bubble helmets.
units.italian: Seguendo le indicazioni di Aliza, posi la <ship> su una piazzola ghiacciata accanto a uno degli edifici più piccoli. Qualche Avgi esce a salutarti, indossando tute spaziali color argento con caschi a bolla comicamente grandi.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"What now?"|1019|0
units.english: "What now?"
units.italian: "E adesso?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"How long until the test?"|1020|0
units.english: "How long until the test?"
units.italian: "Quanto manca al test?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	Aliza checks a clock. "We've got most of the day. Want to help us set up, question?"|1021|0
units.english: Aliza checks a clock. "We've got most of the day. Want to help us set up, question?"
units.italian: Aliza controlla un orologio. "Abbiamo quasi tutta la giornata. Vorresti aiutarci ad allestire, domanda?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Sure, I've got nothing better to do," you say.|1022|0
units.english: "Sure, I've got nothing better to do," you say.
units.italian: "Certo, non ho di meglio da fare," dici.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	What follows is a surprisingly mundane day of helping the crew set up various sensors and instruments at carefully marked distances from ground zero. As you're helping drill a borehole through the ice, through which yet another probe will be dropped, you see a sled in the distance drive by, an innocent-looking teardrop object strapped to its bed. It can't be any bigger than you yourself are, yet this must be the device that will be tested in only a few hours, raised on top of a slim steel tower that has already been erected.|1023|0
units.english: What follows is a surprisingly mundane day of helping the crew set up various sensors and instruments at carefully marked distances from ground zero. As you're helping drill a borehole through the ice, through which yet another probe will be dropped, you see a sled in the distance drive by, an innocent-looking teardrop object strapped to its bed. It can't be any bigger than you yourself are, yet this must be the device that will be tested in only a few hours, raised on top of a slim steel tower that has already been erected.
units.italian: Quello che segue è un giorno sorprendentemente ordinario, passato ad aiutare l'equipaggio a sistemare sensori e strumenti a distanze accuratamente segnate dal punto zero. Mentre aiuti a trivellare un foro nel ghiaccio, attraverso il quale verrà calata un'altra sonda, vedi passare in lontananza una slitta, con un oggetto innocente a forma di goccia legato sul pianale. Non può essere più grande di te, eppure deve essere il dispositivo che sarà collaudato tra poche ore, issato in cima a una sottile torre d'acciaio già eretta.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"So that's an Avgi atomic."|1026|0
units.english: "So that's an Avgi atomic."
units.italian: "Quindi quella è un'atomica Avgi."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	(Continue working.)|1027|0
units.english: (Continue working.)
units.italian: (Continua a lavorare.)

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Yep. This is a mid-sized device, only sixty megatons. Weighs a bit under three tons, so it's a bit large for the tiny little missiles we've been stuck with since the Incursion drove us out here, but I've heard there's a team working on spooling up a production line for a more capable missile bus so that we can get these deployed."|1030|0
units.english: "Yep. This is a mid-sized device, only sixty megatons. Weighs a bit under three tons, so it's a bit large for the tiny little missiles we've been stuck with since the Incursion drove us out here, but I've heard there's a team working on spooling up a production line for a more capable missile bus so that we can get these deployed."
units.italian: "Sì. Questo è un dispositivo di taglia media, solo sessanta megatoni. Pesa poco meno di tre tonnellate, quindi è un po' grande per i minuscoli missili con cui siamo bloccati da quando l'Incursione ci ha scacciati quaggiù, ma ho sentito che una squadra sta lavorando per avviare una linea di produzione per un vettore missilistico più capace, così da poterli schierare."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	She looks suddenly embarrassed. "Worry. But you didn't hear that from me, of course. Information security is a lot more relaxed now that we're all mostly on the same side, but still... can't hurt to be safe."|1031|0
units.english: She looks suddenly embarrassed. "Worry. But you didn't hear that from me, of course. Information security is a lot more relaxed now that we're all mostly on the same side, but still... can't hurt to be safe."
units.italian: Sembra improvvisamente imbarazzata. "Preoccupazione. Ma non l'hai sentito da me, naturalmente. La sicurezza delle informazioni è molto più rilassata ora che siamo quasi tutti dalla stessa parte, ma comunque... non guasta essere prudenti."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	A few hours later, and a quick skim over Dokimi's surface in an Akoustiki Excursion Vehicle, you find yourself in a bunker dug into the ice a few dozen kilometers away. Up in the mountains, you have direct line of sight to the range, which sits just on the horizon.|1034|0
units.english: A few hours later, and a quick skim over Dokimi's surface in an Akoustiki Excursion Vehicle, you find yourself in a bunker dug into the ice a few dozen kilometers away. Up in the mountains, you have direct line of sight to the range, which sits just on the horizon.
units.italian: Poche ore dopo, e una rapida corsa sulla superficie di Dokimi su un Akoustiki Excursion Vehicle, ti ritrovi in un bunker scavato nel ghiaccio a qualche decina di chilometri. Lassù tra le montagne hai la linea di vista diretta sul poligono, che sta proprio sull'orizzonte.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	You stand in silence, hunched over in a bunker not designed to accommodate one of your stature. A few Avgi shuffle awkwardly and try to make small talk, but it invariably trails away into the silence. Someone near the back coughs, an odd whistling sound, as you all stare at the room's sole window, tinted dark enough so as to be black. Finally, over the hum of electric lights, a nameless technician begins counting down together with the clock. "Twelve, eleven, ten, nine..."|1035|0
units.english: You stand in silence, hunched over in a bunker not designed to accommodate one of your stature. A few Avgi shuffle awkwardly and try to make small talk, but it invariably trails away into the silence. Someone near the back coughs, an odd whistling sound, as you all stare at the room's sole window, tinted dark enough so as to be black. Finally, over the hum of electric lights, a nameless technician begins counting down together with the clock. "Twelve, eleven, ten, nine..."
units.italian: Te ne stai in silenzio, curvo in un bunker non progettato per ospitare uno della tua statura. Qualche Avgi si agita goffamente e cerca di fare conversazione, ma questa finisce invariabilmente nel silenzio. Qualcuno verso il fondo tossisce, uno strano suono fischiante, mentre tutti fissate l'unica finestra della stanza, oscurata abbastanza da sembrare nera. Alla fine, sopra il ronzio delle luci elettriche, un tecnico senza nome comincia il conto alla rovescia insieme all'orologio. "Dodici, undici, dieci, nove..."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	You find yourself holding your breath as the countdown inches to zero. "Three, two, one...|1036|0
units.english: You find yourself holding your breath as the countdown inches to zero. "Three, two, one...
units.italian: Ti ritrovi a trattenere il respiro mentre il conto alla rovescia si avvicina allo zero. "Tre, due, uno...

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"...Zero."|1038|0
units.english: "...Zero."
units.italian: "...Zero."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	For a moment, silence. And then, light. Light. Nothing but light, a light that consumes your whole world even as the tinted glass shields your eyes from all but the barest glimpse of its edges. For a handful of seconds, a time that stretches into a lifetime, your whole world is light. Then it dims by a bare margin, merely blinding instead of consuming, and you can tell there is something outside the window other than infinite light, the border where the bunker ends and the landscape begins. And the landscape is illuminated, lit by a sun crafted by mortal hands. A sphere of brilliance rests in the distance, utterly still as it only just touches the planetoid's surface. As it dims with each passing moment, within the new sun you swear you can see something opaque and hard-edged, almost as if it were solid, a shape that burns with primordial fire.|1039|0
units.english: For a moment, silence. And then, light. Light. Nothing but light, a light that consumes your whole world even as the tinted glass shields your eyes from all but the barest glimpse of its edges. For a handful of seconds, a time that stretches into a lifetime, your whole world is light. Then it dims by a bare margin, merely blinding instead of consuming, and you can tell there is something outside the window other than infinite light, the border where the bunker ends and the landscape begins. And the landscape is illuminated, lit by a sun crafted by mortal hands. A sphere of brilliance rests in the distance, utterly still as it only just touches the planetoid's surface. As it dims with each passing moment, within the new sun you swear you can see something opaque and hard-edged, almost as if it were solid, a shape that burns with primordial fire.
units.italian: Per un momento, silenzio. E poi, luce. Luce. Nient'altro che luce, una luce che consuma tutto il tuo mondo anche mentre il vetro oscurato protegge i tuoi occhi da tutto tranne che dal più tenue bagliore dei suoi bordi. Per una manciata di secondi, un tempo che si dilata in una vita intera, tutto il tuo mondo è luce. Poi si attenua di un margine appena percettibile, accecante invece che divorante, e puoi capire che fuori dalla finestra c'è qualcosa oltre alla luce infinita: il confine dove il bunker finisce e comincia il paesaggio. E il paesaggio è illuminato, acceso da un sole fabbricato da mani mortali. Una sfera di splendore riposa in lontananza, del tutto immobile mentre appena sfiora la superficie del planetoide. Mentre si attenua a ogni istante, dentro il nuovo sole giuri di vedere qualcosa di opaco e dai bordi netti, quasi fosse solido, una forma che arde di fuoco primordiale.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	And then the light intensifies again as the brief moment of clarity is unmade, the ball of atomic fire expanding and burning brighter as the plasma cools and becomes transparent once more. Your glimpse into its heart is broken as the planet's ice, flashed into incandescent vapor, shrouds it in a column of mundane fire.|1043|0
units.english: And then the light intensifies again as the brief moment of clarity is unmade, the ball of atomic fire expanding and burning brighter as the plasma cools and becomes transparent once more. Your glimpse into its heart is broken as the planet's ice, flashed into incandescent vapor, shrouds it in a column of mundane fire.
units.italian: E poi la luce si intensifica di nuovo mentre il breve momento di chiarezza si disfa, la palla di fuoco atomica che si espande e brucia più luminosa mentre il plasma si raffredda e torna trasparente. Il tuo sguardo dentro il suo cuore si spezza quando il ghiaccio del pianeta, trasformato in vapore incandescente, la avvolge in una colonna di fuoco comune.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	In the space of a breath the chained heart of a star fades to a mere city-sized ball of flame.|1044|0
units.english: In the space of a breath the chained heart of a star fades to a mere city-sized ball of flame.
units.italian: Nel tempo di un respiro il cuore incatenato di una stella sbiadisce in una semplice palla di fiamma grande quanto una città.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Incredible."|1046|0
units.english: "Incredible."
units.italian: "Incredibile."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Terrifying."|1047|0
units.english: "Terrifying."
units.italian: "Terrificante."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Contemplation. Indeed it is." You turn and see Aliza watching the fireball with you, along with a few others. The rest are dutifully staring at instrument readouts and sensor logs, collecting whatever esoteric knowledge they sought to gain from this test.|1049|0
units.english: "Contemplation. Indeed it is." You turn and see Aliza watching the fireball with you, along with a few others. The rest are dutifully staring at instrument readouts and sensor logs, collecting whatever esoteric knowledge they sought to gain from this test.
units.italian: "Contemplazione. Lo è davvero." Ti volti e vedi Aliza che guarda la palla di fuoco con te, insieme a qualche altro. Gli altri fissano con diligenza le letture degli strumenti e i registri dei sensori, raccogliendo la conoscenza esoterica che cercavano di trarre da questo test.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"So, how did it go?"|1051|0
units.english: "So, how did it go?"
units.italian: "Allora, com'è andata?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"What were you trying to learn from this?"|1052|0
units.english: "What were you trying to learn from this?"
units.italian: "Che cosa cercavate di imparare da questo?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Enthusiasm. The point of this wasn't in the actual bomb - it's an old, reliable design with plenty of heritage, so we know how it works. Rather, we used it essentially as a giant x-ray source to drive a dozen other experiments. That's pretty common in nuclear testing, actually, since experiments that could benefit from a nuke are far more common than new designs that need to be tested. Most of the experiments we ran today were nuclear-driven accelerator tests, using the energy of the explosion to drive a particle beam. Just the laboratory scale for now, but we hope to scale it up into a proper weapon at some point," she says, looking proud.|1054|0
units.english: "Enthusiasm. The point of this wasn't in the actual bomb - it's an old, reliable design with plenty of heritage, so we know how it works. Rather, we used it essentially as a giant x-ray source to drive a dozen other experiments. That's pretty common in nuclear testing, actually, since experiments that could benefit from a nuke are far more common than new designs that need to be tested. Most of the experiments we ran today were nuclear-driven accelerator tests, using the energy of the explosion to drive a particle beam. Just the laboratory scale for now, but we hope to scale it up into a proper weapon at some point," she says, looking proud.
units.italian: "Entusiasmo. Il punto non era la bomba in sé: è un progetto vecchio e affidabile con molta tradizione, quindi sappiamo come funziona. L'abbiamo invece usata essenzialmente come una gigantesca sorgente di raggi X per alimentare una dozzina di altri esperimenti. È piuttosto comune nei test nucleari, a dire il vero, visto che gli esperimenti che potrebbero trarre vantaggio da un'atomica sono molto più comuni dei nuovi progetti da collaudare. La maggior parte degli esperimenti di oggi erano test di acceleratori a guida nucleare, che usano l'energia dell'esplosione per alimentare un fascio di particelle. Per ora solo su scala di laboratorio, ma speriamo di portarla a un'arma vera e propria, prima o poi," dice, con aria orgogliosa.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"That's impressive."|1056|0
units.english: "That's impressive."
units.italian: "È impressionante."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"I didn't know you could use nuclear weapons that way."|1058|0
units.english: "I didn't know you could use nuclear weapons that way."
units.italian: "Non sapevo che si potessero usare le armi nucleari in quel modo."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Oh, that's just scratching the surface. Just using them as a simple bomb is a bit of a waste really, you can use them to drive all sorts of lasers and particle beams, and even kinetics if you know what you're doing. You can push their effective range way up there with the right methods."|1060|0
units.english: "Oh, that's just scratching the surface. Just using them as a simple bomb is a bit of a waste really, you can use them to drive all sorts of lasers and particle beams, and even kinetics if you know what you're doing. You can push their effective range way up there with the right methods."
units.italian: "Oh, questo è solo grattare la superficie. Usarle come semplice bomba è un po' uno spreco, a dire il vero: puoi usarle per alimentare ogni sorta di laser e fasci di particelle, e persino armi cinetiche se sai quello che fai. Puoi spingere la loro gittata effettiva molto in alto con i metodi giusti."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Making nuclear weapons more dangerous is almost scary to think about."|1062|0
units.english: "Making nuclear weapons more dangerous is almost scary to think about."
units.italian: "Rendere le armi nucleari più pericolose fa quasi paura a pensarci."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"That all sounds very interesting. And useful against the Aberrant, too."|1063|0
units.english: "That all sounds very interesting. And useful against the Aberrant, too."
units.italian: "Tutto questo suona molto interessante. E anche utile contro l'Aberrante."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Yes, yes it is," she says. "Now, would you mind giving me a ride back up to Ergastirio, question?"|1066|0
units.english: "Yes, yes it is," she says. "Now, would you mind giving me a ride back up to Ergastirio, question?"
units.italian: "Sì, lo è," dice. "Ora, ti dispiacerebbe riportarmi su a Ergastirio, domanda?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Sure."|1068|0
units.english: "Sure."
units.italian: "Certo."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"No."|1070|0
units.english: "No."
units.italian: "No."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|log|1074|0
units.english: Yinmn is a security specialist working to keep nuclear materials secure and out of the wrong hands. He is apparently quite successful at this.
units.italian: Yinmn è uno specialista della sicurezza che lavora per tenere al sicuro i materiali nucleari e lontani dalle mani sbagliate. A quanto pare ha molto successo in questo.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	You drop off Aliza near the same place you met her, in the main concourse. It's rather more full than last time, with a veritable crowd moving through the room, probably fresh off a transport ship. Aliza seems to spot someone she recognizes. Waving, she drags you over to a dark blue Avgi in dark, steel gray clothing.|1076|0
units.english: You drop off Aliza near the same place you met her, in the main concourse. It's rather more full than last time, with a veritable crowd moving through the room, probably fresh off a transport ship. Aliza seems to spot someone she recognizes. Waving, she drags you over to a dark blue Avgi in dark, steel gray clothing.
units.italian: Lasci Aliza vicino allo stesso posto in cui l'hai incontrata, nel concorso principale. È piuttosto più affollato dell'ultima volta, con una vera folla che attraversa la sala, probabilmente appena sbarcata da una nave di trasporto. Aliza sembra scorgere qualcuno che riconosce. Con un cenno, ti trascina verso un Avgi blu scuro, vestito di abiti grigio acciaio.

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"This is my colleague, Yinmn," she says. "And this is Captain <first> <last>."|1077|0
units.english: "This is my colleague, Yinmn," she says. "And this is Captain <first> <last>."
units.italian: "Questo è il mio collega, Yinmn," dice. "E questo è il capitano <first> <last>."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Greetings. Hey there. I work in the accounting section for Ergastirio. And you're of course Captain <last>, the alien everyone's been talking about."|1078|0
units.english: "Greetings. Hey there. I work in the accounting section for Ergastirio. And you're of course Captain <last>, the alien everyone's been talking about."
units.italian: "Salve. Ehi. Lavoro nella sezione contabilità di Ergastirio. E tu sei naturalmente il capitano <last>, l'alieno di cui tutti parlano."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Huh, what do you do there?"|1080|0
units.english: "Huh, what do you do there?"
units.italian: "Ah, che cosa ci fai lì?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Accounting? That's an odd job for a lab."|1082|0
units.english: "Accounting? That's an odd job for a lab."
units.italian: "Contabilità? È un lavoro strano per un laboratorio."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	Yinmn hums with laughter. "Amusement, not that kind of accounting. I account for nuclear materials, not credits. We have to make sure every last drop of fissiles that could be used to make a bomb is kept secure. Not only for security reasons, but because it's extremely valuable out here in the Outer Limits. Not many of the heavier elements out here, sadly, and we've been having issues with shortages lately. It only takes a few kilos to make a bomb, but we do go through a lot of them..."|1084|0
units.english: Yinmn hums with laughter. "Amusement, not that kind of accounting. I account for nuclear materials, not credits. We have to make sure every last drop of fissiles that could be used to make a bomb is kept secure. Not only for security reasons, but because it's extremely valuable out here in the Outer Limits. Not many of the heavier elements out here, sadly, and we've been having issues with shortages lately. It only takes a few kilos to make a bomb, but we do go through a lot of them..."
units.italian: Yinmn vibra di risate. "Divertimento, non quel tipo di contabilità. Tengo i conti dei materiali nucleari, non dei crediti. Dobbiamo assicurarci che ogni ultima goccia di fissile che potrebbe servire a fare una bomba resti al sicuro. Non solo per ragioni di sicurezza, ma perché qui negli Outer Limits vale moltissimo. Non ci sono molti elementi pesanti da queste parti, purtroppo, e ultimamente abbiamo avuto problemi di carenza. Bastano pochi chili per fare una bomba, ma ne consumiamo parecchi..."

Bastano pochi chili per fare una bomba, ma ne consumiamo parecchi..."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	Aliza chimes in. "And a lot of people, especially certain elements in the Dissonance, would like to get their hands on some of our stockpile of fissile materials. We do quite a bit of mining, and have an impressive amount of breeder reactors running on fusion neutrons, so the amount of material being circulated at any given moment is quite high. Yinmn could tell you a lot of stories about the piracy that goes on with that supply chain."|1091|0
units.english: Aliza chimes in. "And a lot of people, especially certain elements in the Dissonance, would like to get their hands on some of our stockpile of fissile materials. We do quite a bit of mining, and have an impressive amount of breeder reactors running on fusion neutrons, so the amount of material being circulated at any given moment is quite high. Yinmn could tell you a lot of stories about the piracy that goes on with that supply chain."
units.italian: Aliza interviene. "E molte persone, soprattutto certi elementi della Dissonanza, vorrebbero mettere le mani su una parte delle nostre scorte di materiali fissili. Facciamo parecchia estrazione mineraria, e abbiamo un numero impressionante di reattori autofertilizzanti alimentati da neutroni di fusione, quindi la quantità di materiale in circolazione in un dato momento è piuttosto alta. Yinmn potrebbe raccontarti un sacco di storie sulla pirateria che accompagna quella catena di fornitura."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	Yinmn taps his arms together. "Heh, but we'd be here for days, amusement. I'll just leave it at this: our convoys are often trailed by 'merchants' apparently making supply runs to secure facilities. Those are the worst, not the members of the Dissonance themselves, but the ones who hide their sympathies and feign loyalty to the Consonance."|1092|0
units.english: Yinmn taps his arms together. "Heh, but we'd be here for days, amusement. I'll just leave it at this: our convoys are often trailed by 'merchants' apparently making supply runs to secure facilities. Those are the worst, not the members of the Dissonance themselves, but the ones who hide their sympathies and feign loyalty to the Consonance."
units.italian: Yinmn batte i bracci uno contro l'altro. "Eh, ma staremmo qui per giorni, divertimento. Mi limiterò a dire questo: i nostri convogli sono spesso seguiti da 'mercanti' che a quanto pare fanno rifornimenti verso strutture sicure. Quelli sono i peggiori, non i membri della Dissonanza in sé, ma quelli che nascondono le loro simpatie e fingono lealtà alla Consonanza."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Wait, so do they have nukes too?"|1094|0
units.english: "Wait, so do they have nukes too?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, quindi hanno anche loro le atomiche?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Have you ever lost any nuclear material to them?"|1096|0
units.english: "Have you ever lost any nuclear material to them?"
units.italian: "Avete mai perso materiale nucleare a causa loro?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Pride. Not under my watch. But, well, I'm not exactly the only Accountant in the Consonance. So yes, material has gone missing before. Rarely through overt piracy, but usually because someone 'forgot' to record the true amount in a shipment, or because it was allocated to a captain that didn't really exist."|1098|0
units.english: "Pride. Not under my watch. But, well, I'm not exactly the only Accountant in the Consonance. So yes, material has gone missing before. Rarely through overt piracy, but usually because someone 'forgot' to record the true amount in a shipment, or because it was allocated to a captain that didn't really exist."
units.italian: "Orgoglio. Non sotto la mia sorveglianza. Ma, beh, non sono esattamente l'unico contabile della Consonanza. Quindi sì, del materiale è sparito in passato. Raramente per pirateria aperta, ma di solito perché qualcuno ha 'dimenticato' di registrare la quantità reale in una spedizione, o perché è stato assegnato a un capitano che non esisteva davvero."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Oh, of course they do. Even if they weren't stealing from us, which is risky but has an enormous potential payout, they have all the tools you'd need to breed or enrich fissile materials on their own, so no doubt do they have a stockpile of weapons themselves."|1102|0
units.english: "Oh, of course they do. Even if they weren't stealing from us, which is risky but has an enormous potential payout, they have all the tools you'd need to breed or enrich fissile materials on their own, so no doubt do they have a stockpile of weapons themselves."
units.italian: "Oh, certo che le hanno. Anche se non ci rubassero nulla, cosa rischiosa ma con un potenziale guadagno enorme, hanno tutti gli strumenti necessari per produrre o arricchire materiali fissili da soli, quindi senza dubbio hanno anche loro una scorta di armi."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Sounds like you could use some help with security."|1107|0
units.english: "Sounds like you could use some help with security."
units.italian: "Sembra che potreste usare un aiuto con la sicurezza."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Is there a way I could help escort those shipments?"|1108|0
units.english: "Is there a way I could help escort those shipments?"
units.italian: "C'è un modo per cui possa aiutare a scortare quelle spedizioni?"

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	Yinmn thinks for a moment. "Consideration. Well, we usually have the Twilight Guard escort them, but with how thin they've been stretched lately, with those latest Aberrant incursions into the Tangled Shroud, any kind of relief would go a long way. I could look into whether you could be eligible to help with escort duties - as one of only a few aliens we've ever met, you could ironically be more trustworthy than just another random Avgi captain. Be on the lookout for opportunities on the job board, if I can make this work out."|1110|0
units.english: Yinmn thinks for a moment. "Consideration. Well, we usually have the Twilight Guard escort them, but with how thin they've been stretched lately, with those latest Aberrant incursions into the Tangled Shroud, any kind of relief would go a long way. I could look into whether you could be eligible to help with escort duties - as one of only a few aliens we've ever met, you could ironically be more trustworthy than just another random Avgi captain. Be on the lookout for opportunities on the job board, if I can make this work out."
units.italian: Yinmn riflette un momento. "Considerazione. Beh, di solito è la Twilight Guard a scortarle, ma con quanto sono stati diluiti ultimamente, con quelle ultime incursioni dell'Aberrante nel Tangled Shroud, qualsiasi tipo di sollievo aiuterebbe molto. Potrei informarmi se tu possa essere idoneo ad aiutare con i compiti di scorta: come uno dei pochi alieni che abbiamo mai incontrato, potresti ironicamente essere più affidabile di un altro capitano Avgi qualsiasi. Tieni d'occhio le occasioni sulla bacheca degli incarichi, se riesco a far funzionare la cosa."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"I will."|1114|0
units.english: "I will."
units.italian: "Lo farò."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Sounds good."|1115|0
units.english: "Sounds good."
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene."

units.id: mission:Avgi: Atomics Testing 2|	"Appreciation. Well, it was a pleasure to meet you, <first>, but I've got to go start analyzing the data from the test," Aliza says. "If you're ever around Ergastirio or Dokimi, feel free to stop by and chat. I'm sure we'll see more of each other in the future."|1117|0
units.english: "Appreciation. Well, it was a pleasure to meet you, <first>, but I've got to go start analyzing the data from the test," Aliza says. "If you're ever around Ergastirio or Dokimi, feel free to stop by and chat. I'm sure we'll see more of each other in the future."
units.italian: "Riconoscenza. Beh, è stato un piacere conoscerti, <first>, ma devo andare a cominciare ad analizzare i dati del test," dice Aliza. "Se mai ti trovi nei paraggi di Ergastirio o di Dokimi, passa pure a fare due chiacchiere. Sono sicura che ci vedremo ancora, in futuro."
